title: (Senior) Director Of Post Sales Operations
description:
**About Us**
**nShift** 
 is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 500 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.
   

  

 Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!
   

  

 If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.
   

  

**Purpose of Role**
 We are creating a new senior role to partner directly with our Chief Customer Officer (CCO) in transforming a post-sales organisation of roughly 140 people across Support, Carrier Integration, and Professional Services, spanning multiple European geographies.
   

  

 This is not a coordination or reporting role. Given how dispersed the organisation is, this person's presence in our offices — running workshops, working alongside teams, building solutions on the ground — is itself part of how we bring the CCO's leadership closer to the frontline. The role exists to personally own and deliver our highest-priority transformation initiatives, not to track them.
   

  

**Please note that this is not a leadership role**
**Overall Responsibility**
 The (Senior) Director Of Post Sales Operations to the CCO will lead the hands-on delivery of transformation initiatives across the post-sales organisation, reporting to the Chief Customer Officer. This is an execution-first role: leading workshops, building AI-enabled tools and workflows, and driving initiatives from idea through to working reality, in close partnership with functional leaders across Support, Carrier Integration, and Professional Services. Frequent travel across our European offices is expected and central to how this role operates.
   

  

**Competence And Experience**
 The area of responsibility includes:
   

  

**Hands-On Transformation Leadership**
* Personally lead and deliver the CCO's highest-priority transformation initiatives across Support, Carrier Integration, and Professional Services, from design through to execution.
* Run and facilitate working sessions and workshops directly with functional leaders and frontline teams to design new ways of working.
* Take initiatives from idea to built reality, working alongside the teams doing the work rather than directing from a distance.


**AI Fluency & Building**
* Bring genuine, hands-on AI fluency: able to build or prototype AI-enabled workflows, tools, or automations that remove friction from post-sales operations.
* Identify where AI and automation can accelerate transformation across the three functions, and personally help stand up early solutions rather than only scoping them for others.


**Cross-Functional Execution**
* Translate the CCO's strategic priorities into concrete, deliverable initiatives that span more than one of the three functions.
* Actively manage cross-functional handoffs and dependencies so initiatives land, not just get tracked.
* Represent the CCO in forums and decisions where direct involvement isn't required.


**Frontline Presence & Stakeholder Management**
* Spend significant time in person across our European offices, bringing visible leadership presence to a highly dispersed team.
* Build genuine, trusted working relationships with functional leaders and frontline staff across Support, Carrier Integration, and Professional Services.
* Support internal talent development and act as a connector between frontline teams and the executive team.


**Key Requirements**
**Experience & Background**
* 10+ years in senior post-sales, customer operations, or transformation leadership roles within B2B SaaS, ideally spanning more than one of: Support, Professional Services, Customer Success, or Partner/Integration functions.
* A demonstrated track record of personally building things — an AI-enabled tool, an automated workflow, a from-scratch operating model, or similar — not just directing others to build them.
* Experience leading hands-on transformation or operating-model change, including running workshops and driving execution to completion.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity, building structure where none exists yet, without waiting for a fully-formed mandate.
* Experience navigating senior leadership environments and translating complex operational issues into clear, actionable decisions.


**Skills & Attributes**
* Genuine, hands-on AI fluency — comfortable building or prototyping with AI tools, not just directing others to.
* Strong facilitation skills; able to run a workshop and drive a room to a decision.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to distil complexity into clear, direct recommendations.
* Fluent written and spoken English.


**Behaviours & Competencies**
* Builder mindset: prefers doing to directing, and delivering to reporting.
* Structured, decisive, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment.
* Genuinely willing to travel frequently across our European offices — this role is defined by frontline presence, not remote coordination.
* Collaborative, low-ego partner to functional leaders across Support, Carrier Integration, and Professional Services.


**Why This Role Matters**
 A post-sales organisation this dispersed doesn't transform through dashboards and steering committees alone — it transforms when someone senior enough to matter is in the room, building the solution alongside the team that has to live with it. This role brings that presence and that capability directly into the CCO's leadership, turning strategic priorities into things that actually get built.
   

  

**Please ensure you upload your CV in English**
 At nShift we believe in embracing diversity in all forms and fostering an inclusive environment for everyone which we believe is essential for our continued success. We're an equal-opportunity employer which means that all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity, or disability status.

title: Enterprise Sales Manager EMEA – Cyber Security to Axiomatics
description:
**Enterprise Sales Manager EMEA – Cyber Security** 




 Drive enterprise cybersecurity sales across EMEA at Axiomatics, shaping the future of Zero Trust and access control by delivering cutting-edge ABAC solutions to global organizations (pitch for ad)
 



 Do you want to help shape the future of cybersecurity?
 



  





 At Axiomatics, we develop world-leading solutions for Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC), protecting critical data for banks, government agencies, and global enterprises. Here, you will work with cutting-edge technology, Zero Trust strategies, and complex security solutions making a real impact every day.
 



  





 Axiomatics, headquartered in central Stockholm, was founded in 2006 and has since established itself as a leading provider of dynamic authorization and fine-grained access control based on an attribute- and policy-driven model (ABAC) for applications, data, APIs, and microservices.
 



 Through our platform, we enable organizations to share and protect sensitive digital assets ensuring that access is granted only to the right users in the right context. Read more at www.axiomatics.com.
 



  





**About the role** 




 In this role, you will drive new enterprise sales opportunities across the EMEA region within defined target markets, taking full ownership of the entire sales cycle from lead qualification through to contract negotiation and closing. You will work closely with customers to understand complex authorization and access control challenges, collaborating with technical presales and product teams to deliver tailored solutions.
 



  





 Key responsibilities include:
 


* Driving new enterprise sales opportunities across the EMEA region
* Owning the full sales cycle from lead qualification to contract negotiation and closing
* Conducting structured discovery to identify complex authorization and access control challenges
* Collaborating with presales and product teams to align solutions with customer requirements
* Leading RFI/RFP responses and coordinating technical validation activities such as POCs and architecture reviews
* Engaging senior stakeholders, including CISOs, IAM leaders, enterprise architects, and procurement teams
* Maintaining a disciplined sales pipeline and accurate forecasting in CRM systems
* Developing strategic account plans for high-value enterprise prospects
* Representing Axiomatics at relevant cybersecurity events and industry forums when required



  





**Your profile** 




 We are looking for a candidate with a solid academic background, ideally holding a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. You bring a strong foundation in B2B sales within IT security, cybersecurity, or Identity and Access Management (IAM), and are comfortable navigating complex enterprise environments.
 



 You have a proven ability to drive sales of complex software solutions and manage multi-stakeholder sales processes from start to finish. You are confident engaging with both business and technical stakeholders, including security architects, IAM specialists, and enterprise architects, and can translate technical concepts into clear business value.
 



  





 To succeed in this role, we believe you have:
 


* at least 3 years of experience in B2B sales within IT security, cybersecurity, or IAM
* a strong track record of selling complex enterprise software solutions
* experience managing long and complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders
* the ability to build credibility and engage with technical decision-makers
* experience working with regulated industries such as finance, government, healthcare, or industrial sectors (highly desirable)
* experience working closely with customer success teams or in a customer-facing role within a cybersecurity or IAM company



  





 You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
 



  





 It is considered a strong advantage if you have a technical background, for example in solution engineering, security engineering, or development, enabling you to confidently participate in in-depth technical discussions. Experience in selling authorization, IAM, PAM, IGA, or Zero Trust solutions is highly valued. Experience working across multiple European markets, within channel sales environments, and an established network within the European cybersecurity ecosystem are also considered strong assets.
 



  





**Personal skills** 




 We are looking for a highly driven and structured individual with strong consultative selling skills and the ability to build trust with senior stakeholders. You are comfortable navigating complex organizations and can clearly understand and articulate technical concepts in a way that resonates with both business and technical audiences. You bring a disciplined and structured approach to pipeline management, combined with a high level of self-management and accountability. In complex enterprise sales environments, you are resilient, persistent, and able to maintain momentum throughout long sales cycles.
 



  





**What Axiomatics offers** 




 At Axiomatics, you will have the opportunity to work with advanced technology in fine-grained access control and be part of solutions used by large global enterprises and government organizations that rely on our products to protect their most critical assets. You will join an inspiring, technically strong environment characterized by trust, curiosity, and technical excellence, where continuous learning and professional development are a natural part of everyday work. You will also have the opportunity to influence, take ownership, and contribute directly to our customers’ success in their security journeys.
 



  





**Other Information** 




 For this recruitment, we are collaborating with Inhouse IT & Tech. This is a full-time, permanent position based at our office in central Stockholm. We do not accept applications via email; please apply via www.inhouse.se. If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact recruitment consultant Louise Hagen Furugård at louise.furugard@inhouse.se, +46 73 311 87 26.
 



  





 Apply today, selection is ongoing!

If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Major Account Manager partners with our customers to secure their entire digital experience. \* You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. This role is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks Is Leading The Charge In Platformization, Offering Best-in-breed Solutions That Enable Customers To Build a Truly Zero-trust Security Architecture And Navigate Critical Transformations. To Ensure Our Sales Team Is Equipped To Guide Customers, We've Developed FLIGHT, An Immersive Onboarding Program
   

  

 Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions.
   

  

 This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.
   

  

 Your Impact
   

  

* As a Major Account Manager, you will drive and orchestrate large complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer.

* Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the portfolio of Palo Alto Networks solutions.

 Minimum 15 years experience including 6 years in large Enterprise SaaS or IT Security companies
   

  

**Minimum 15 Years Enterprise Sales Experience**
 Fluent Swedish
   

  

**Preferred**
 Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security industry.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience selling complex solutions, value selling, and/or consultative sales techniques Technical aptitude for understanding how technology products and solutions solve business problems
   

  

 Demonstrates in depth knowledge of the full sales cycle and the ability to follow a structured sales process Ability to take a holistic approach to problem solving by understanding the bigger picture, and considering complex interrelationships and outcomes Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction
   

  

**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Teknisk beställare mot Telecom
description:

Delsystemen som du jobbar med är styr- och reglersystem, IP-nät, spaningsradar och ledningssystem. Med professionella medarbetare genomför och utvecklar vi verksamheten tillsammans med övriga Försvarsmakten samt i nära samarbete med Försvarets materielverk (FMV) och industrin. Avdelningen (DSK) består av ca 100 medarbetare fördelade på fyra orter; Karlskrona, Berga, Muskö samt Göteborg. Tjänsten benämns Systemingenjör Tele i Försvarsmakten.

description:

title: Doktorand inom maskininlärning och optimering
description:
**Projektbeskrivning**




**Forskarutbildningsämne: Datalogi**




 KTH välkomnar nu begåvade och stark motiverade kandidater att söka denna doktorandposition.  Doktoranden kommer att utveckla nya algoritmer och välgrundade metoder, formalisera deras teoretiska grunder och utvärdera dem experimentellt. Forskningen har en bred inriktning inom maskininlärning och kan bland annat omfatta algoritmisk kunskapsutvinning, datautvinning ur grafer och analys av sociala nätverk, optimering för maskininlärning, representationsinlärning samt rättvis, ansvarsskyldig och transparent maskininlärning.
   

  





 Denna doktorandanställning i maskininlärning leder till en gemensam doktorsexamen från KTH (Sverige) och Nanyang Technological University (NTU, Singapore). Den som anställs antas till forskarutbildning vid KTH och tillbringar minst tolv månader vid NTU inom ramen för programmet.
   

  





**Handledning:** 
 Prof. Aristides Gionis (KTH), Sebastian Dalleiger (KTH), Kelly Ke Yiping (NTU)
   

  





**Behörighet för antagning**




 För att bli antagen till forskarutbildning (kap 7 39 § högskoleförordningen) krävs att den sökande har grundläggande behörighet:
 


* avlagt en examen på avancerad nivå, eller
* fullgjort kursfordringar om minst 240 högskolepoäng, varav minst 60 högskolepoäng på avancerad nivå, eller
* på något annat sätt inom eller utom landet förvärvat i huvudsak motsvarande kunskaper.



 Kandidaten måste kunna åta sig en forskningsvistelse på minst tolv månader vid NTU i Singapore. Detta är ett krav för denna specifika position. 
   

  





 Utöver ovanstående  finns också ett obligatoriskt krav på engelska motsvarande Engelska B/6.
   

  





**Urval**




 För att lyckas med dina doktorandstudier på KTH behöver du vara målinriktad och ihärdig i ditt arbete. Vid urval av de sökande bedöms förmågan att:
 


* självständigt driva sitt arbete framåt,
* kunna samarbeta med andra,
* ha ett professionellt förhållningssätt,
* analysera och arbeta med komplexa frågor.



 Den sökande ska ha avlagt, eller vara nära att avlägga, masterexamen inom datalogi, maskininlärning, AI, datavetenskap eller närliggande område.
   

  





 Den sökande ska ha starka akademiska meriter, styrkta genom mycket goda studieresultat eller relevanta projekt.
   

  





 Den sökande bör vara starkt motiverad och inneha goda kunskaper inom ett eller flera av följande områden: algoritmdesign, maskininlärning, matematisk optimering och inlärningsteori. Vidare bör den sökande ha goda programmeringskunskaper för att kunna implementera algoritmer och utvärdera deras prestanda. 
   

  





 Efter behörighetskraven kommer stor vikt läggas vid personliga egenskaper.
   

  





**Målexamen: Doktorsexamen**




**Information om antagning och anställning**




 Endast den som antagits till forskarutbildning får anställas som doktorand. Den sammanlagda anställningstiden får inte vara längre än vad som motsvarar utbildning på forskarnivå på heltid under fyra år. En anställd doktorand kan i begränsad omfattning (högst 20 %) utföra vissa arbetsuppgifter inom t.ex. utbildning och administration. En ny anställning som doktorand gäller för högst ett år, anställningen får därefter förnyas med högst två år i taget. Vid studier som ska avslutas med licentiatexamen får den sammanlagda anställningstiden inte vara längre än vad som motsvarar utbildning på forskarnivå på heltid under två år.
   

  





 Som doktorand får du del av KTH:s anställningsförmåner och har en månadslön enligt KTH:s avtal för doktorandlöner. Läs mer om Forskarstudier vid KTH | KTH | Sweden.
   

  





**Fackliga representanter**




 Kontaktuppgifter till fackliga representanter.
   

  





**Doktorandsektionen (Tekniska högskolans studentkår)**




 Kontaktuppgifter till
 
 doktorandsektionen.
   

  





**Ansökan**




 Du ansöker via KTH:s rekryteringssystem. Du som sökande har huvudansvaret för att din ansökan är komplett när den skickas in.
   

  





 Ansökan ska ha följande innehåll
 


* Kopior av examensbevis och betyg från tidigare universitetsstudier och intyg på uppfyllda språkkrav (se ovan). Översättningar till engelska eller svenska om originaldokumentet inte är utfärdade på ett av dessa språk. Kopior av original ska vidimeras
* CV med relevanta professionella erfarenheter och kunskaper.
* Ansökningsbrev med en kortfattad redogörelse om varför du vill bedriva forskarstudier, om dina akademiska intressen och hur de relaterar till dina tidigare studier och framtida mål. (Max 2 sidor)
* Representativa publikationer eller tekniska rapporter. För längre dokument, bifoga gärna en sammanfattning (abstract) och en webblänk till den fullständiga texten



 Ansökan ska vara KTH tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdagen vid midnatt, CET/CEST (Central European Time/Central European Summer Time). 
   

  





**Övrigt**




 För information om behandling av personuppgifter i samband med rekrytering.
   

  





 Det kan förekomma att en anställning hos KTH är placerad i säkerhetsklass. Om så är fallet för just denna anställning görs en säkerhetsprövning av sökande i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) efter samtycke. I dessa fall är en förutsättning för anställning att sökande blir godkänd efter säkerhetsprövning.
   

  





 Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av platsannonser.
   

  





**Bli en del av KTH**




 KTH formar framtiden genom utbildning, forskning och innovation. Som ett ledande internationellt tekniskt universitet spelar vi en aktiv roll i att driva och medverka i omställningen till ett hållbart samhälle. Här erbjuds du möjligheten att växa och utvecklas på en kreativ och dynamisk arbetsplats med goda arbetsvillkor och förmåner. Jämställdhet, mångfald och lika villkor är en kvalitetsfråga och en självklar del av KTH:s värdegrund som universitet och statlig myndighet.
   

  





 Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att arbeta och utvecklas på KTH.
