title: Senior Solutions Architect, Software and Technology Companies, Europe-North
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you passionate about guiding top software companies in the Nordics or Benelux area (Europe-North) in their global innovation and acceleration? Do you want to help our customers adopt agile operation models, build modern SaaS architectures, and help them be at the forefront of their Generative AI transformation?  

  

Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help them make the most of the Cloud. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with organizations at all stages of cloud adoption. Solutions Architects also take a leading role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.  

  

Solutions Architects own the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS. They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology.  

  

In this role you will get to practice your creativity, linking technology to tangible solutions and educating AWS customers about the art of the possible. You will have the opportunity to define or invent cloud-native reference architectures for a variety of use cases. You will have the support to grow your expertise in software industry and technology areas of depth. Every day you will be learning something new from your customers, your peers and your own experiments.  

  

At Amazon you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is right for the long-term success of the customer. We value your passion to discover, invent and build on behalf of customers.  

  

Come build the future with us.  

  

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and unwavering support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Solutions Architect, you will work directly with customers to accelerate their mission-critical projects and recommend best-practice architectures in line with their long-term business outcomes.  

  

You will also:  

  

* Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud.
* You will own the technical relationship with the customer and operate as their trusted advisor. The best interests of the customer will shape the guidance you provide. You will share the voice of the customer to influence the roadmap of new features and services for the AWS platform.
* Take a leading role in the creation and capture of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts). Evangelize and educate about AWS technology and industry trends (e.g. workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
* Contribute to the growth of the Solutions Architecture organization by hiring, coaching and mentoring others.
* Develop areas of depth in technical domains relevant to your interests and your customer's outcomes.

  

A day in the life  

You will have the opportunity to work with account managers to help ISV customers accelerate their cloud implementation to modernize their business on AWS. Working with these customers, you will help them transform existing workloads by designing modern target architectures optimized for business agility, innovation, performance, resiliency, cost, security, and more using both native and partner solutions.  

  

Our teams focus on understanding customer key business drivers as well as the existing application architecture(s) to deliver a technical recommendation to the customer with a goal of designing a robust cloud architecture that can scale as their business requires.  

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship & Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

The AWS ISV Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to working with software companies. We’re here to help customers to design and build some of the most scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures and solutions – cost efficiently to enable them to expand their business globally.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 4+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product and technical challenges
* Experience in managing complex sales processes with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* AWS Certifications(e.g., AWS Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional)
* Experience architecting or migrating workloads on AWS or other major cloud platforms(Azure, GCP)
* Experience creating technical content(white papers, reference architectures, blog posts) or delivering public-facing presentations (workshops, meetups, conferences)
* Familiarity with enterprise IT landscapes in Nordics, Benelux or the broader EMEA region, including ISV/SaaS partner ecosystems
* Expertise in one or more of the following: DevOps, Containers, Serverless, Data Analytics, AI/ML, Application Migration & Modernisation and Business Transformation.

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a
 **Cloud Engineer** 
 who enjoys working in the space where developers and infrastructure meet. Here, you’ll spend your time automating the mundane, architecting the complex, and scaling the future of our Azure AI and OpenAI offerings. This role is for you if you find more joy in writing a PowerShell script to solve a recurring app error than in managing a cluster’s networking.
   

  

 This is a code-centric role where infrastructure is treated as a software product. Everything you build is versioned, reviewed, tested, and continuously improved. Our goal is to reduce repetitive work and create the “Golden Paths” that let developers and AI teams deploy quickly, securely, and reliably.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll help build and grow our Azure-based platform. You’ll own the design, automation, and delivery of modular cloud infrastructure, ensuring it’s resilient, scalable, and easy for teams to use. Your work will reduce friction, remove unnecessary steps, and make it simple for developers and data teams to focus on building features instead of worrying about infrastructure.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Build the "Golden Path" Pipelines: You won't just "run" pipelines; you will architect them. You’ll design and maintain CI/CD templates (YAML-based) that standardize how our applications are built, tested, and deployed. Your goal is to make the path from code-complete to production-ready as invisible and frictionless as possible for our developers.
* Automated Application Remediation: We don't believe in manual maintenance. You will use PowerShell and Azure DevOps to build automated pipelines for things like patching the container OS, reporting on deviations and self healing infrastructure
* Infrastructure as Versioned Code: You’ll design and implement modular Azure infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), following the Azure Well-Architected Framework for reliability, performance, and cost.


**We Are Looking For You Who Have**
* Expert-level PowerShell skills: We operate in an environment where automation is built on PowerShell first. (Bash & Python are secondary)
* Proven experience with Azure Bicep: You should be comfortable treating infrastructure as a software product, versioning, testing and modularizing Bicep code.
* Developer-centric approach: You don't need to be a fullstack developer, but you need to understand application logic enough to automate patching, troubleshoot database connections, and optimize application performance within the cloud.
* Fluency in English (written and spoken).


 You’ll be comfortable owning tasks end to end and making technical decisions independently within the areas listed above. Ideally, you have some years of hands-on experience with Azure, containers, and CI/CD pipelines, but we care more about what you can do and that you enjoy the field, rather than the exact number of years.
   

  

**It's Positive If You Have**
* Active Azure certifications such as AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer), AZ-305 (Solutions Architect), AZ-204 (Developer Associate)
* Experience from regulated or security-conscious environments is a plus


 In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.
   

  

 Read more about NOBA Benefits here: https://careers.noba.bank/pages/information
   

  

**Have you heard of NOBAVERSE?**
 In our NOBAVERSE, we value openness, trust, and diversity. Here, you can influence your own development and have fun along the way to achieving our goals – all in a workplace that’s a little extra
 *bubbly* 
 ! ✨
   

  

 Read more about our employee value proposition on our careers page.
   

  

**Read more about how our recruitment process works in the** 
**FAQ** 
**.**
 We care for your privacy and, with reference to the GDPR, would like to ask you not to include any sensitive personal data in your application, for examples information about ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs or information about your health.
   

  

**Read more about how we handle your personal data** 
**here** 
**.**
 If you have any questions or concerns about the position, please contact the responsible recruiter.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application! 🙏✨

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 At Worldline, delivering an awesome payment experience that our customers love is what we burn for. Our cloud-native acquiring platform is processing billions of card transactions including authorization processing and clearing and settlement for our customers to trust. Currently, we are looking for a skilled platform-focused DevOps Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team, where you'll focus on creating scalable, self-service infrastructure solutions that empower our product teams.
   

  

**Day-to-day Responsibilities**
 You will help build the Engineering Platform, enabling developers to independently create, test, launch, manage, and monitor real-time authorization platform through self-service and continuous improvement. As part of a dedicated, domain-focused team, you will help design and deliver an internal platform that:
   

  

* Empowers development teams with seamless, self-service access to tools and technologies
* Minimizes non-development overhead and cross-team delays
* Reduces cognitive load around security, governance, and compliance
* Enables fast, independent software delivery
* Measures success through clear, observable business outcomes


 Your work will directly support internal teams in innovating, building, and operating at scale, and will include participating in an on-call rotation schedule.
   

  

**Who Are We Looking For**
**Who you are**
* Comfortable working independently, with a bias for action.
* Thrives in ambiguous spaces where there isn't a clear solution.
* Enjoys digging into new problems and unfamiliar codebases.
* Excels at written and verbal communication.
* Proven backend software engineering experience.
* Proficiency in developing with programming languages like Python.
* Familiarity with infrastructure components such as CI/CD, monitoring, logging, containers, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Familiarity with HTTP, developing REST and web APIs.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills


**What We Can’t Do Without**
* We're looking for a skilled developer with at least 2–4 years of hands-on experience delivering real work in production environments, especially with Python. You know your way around version control.
* You have practical experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins and Docker for containerization, ideally within AWS ECS.
* You've worked with core AWS services — think ELB, Route53, Lambda, IAM, S3, RDS.
* Have a strong understanding of cloud-native networking basics like VPCs, subnets, and security groups, load balancing.
* You have hands-on experience writing and applying Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation) to provision and manage cloud resources.
* You have a basic understanding of SSO, user authentication, and access control concepts, with some exposure to protocols like OAuth 2.0.
* Degree in Computer Science, engineering, or similar. Fluent in English and/or Swedish with a valid Swedish work permit.
* If this sounds like a good fit, we'd love to hear from you.


**Skills We’d Like**
* Hands-on experience with DevOps culture, automation, lean processes, metrics, and resilience.
* Familiarity with observability tooling — logs, metrics, traces — and a mindset that "it's not done until it's monitored."
* AWS certification (Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer track) is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.
* Demonstrable AWS experience across compute, networking, storage, and security services.
* Publicly available code, writing, or projects that showcase your experience.
* Experience from developing secure and/or PCI-DSS certified solutions is considered an advantage.


**Perks & Benefits**
 In addition to joining a global leader in digital transformation, you can also expect a fantastic range of benefits. These include: a rewarding salary, 30 days’ annual leave, private medical insurance, preventive healtcare, an attractive stakeholder pension scheme, benefit portal plus many more. We also operate a flexible benefits scheme, allowing you to purchase discounted products and services.
   

  

 What’s more, we really value your progress and it’s a top priority to engage, inspire and develop you to help you maximize your potential. In fact, we have comprehensive training and development programs in place demonstrating our commitment to developing your career.
   

  

**Shape the evolution**
 We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com
   

  

 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: AI-Utvecklare
description:
Vill du utveckla AI- och ML-tjänster som faktiskt går i produktion och gör verklig skillnad för människor och djur? Hos oss får du kombinera modern fullstackutveckling med avancerad AI, från NLP och chatbotar till bildigenkänning, i en miljö där du är med och formar både arkitektur och lösning.
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 Du blir en central del i ett team som bygger intelligenta tjänster ovanpå en modern Azure-plattform. Här jobbar du både med klassisk systemutveckling och hands-on AI-utveckling. Du rör dig obehindrat mellan backend i .NET, frontend i React och AI-komponenter i Python, och du är med hela vägen från idé och prototyp till produktion och vidare optimering.
   

  

 IT och affären jobbar nära tillsammans, vilket betyder att du snabbt ser effekten av det du bygger. Du samarbetar tätt med andra utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa att våra lösningar hänger ihop från frontend till backend – och att AI-funktionaliteten faktiskt används och skapar värde.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att:
   

  

* Bygga moderna frontend-lösningar med React, TypeScript och microfrontend-arkitektur
* Jobba testdrivet och bidra till hög kvalitet i koden
* Designa och implementera integrationer med både synkrona och asynkrona mönster
* Vara delaktig i mjukvaruarkitektur och tekniska vägval
* Bygga och optimera CI/CD-pipelines med Azure och Azure DevOps
* Automatisera miljöer och infrastruktur med Bicep
* Utveckla och implementera avancerade AI-lösningar med fokus på NLP, intelligenta system och bildigenkänning
* Bygga, integrera och optimera chatbotar och språkmodeller (inklusive generativ AI)


 För att lyckas i tjänsten tror vi att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av generativ AI och av att ha deployat applikationer i produktion
* God kunskap av fullstack-utveckling med .NET och React
* Vana av testdriven eller testfokuserad utveckling
* Erfarenhet av integration mot synkrona och asynkrona gränssnitt/mönster
* Förståelse för mjukvaruarkitektur och hur man bygger skalbara lösningar
* Erfarenhet av att bygga CI/CD-pipelines med Azure som målplattform
* Kunskaper i Bicep
* Flytande i både svenska och engelska


 Som person är du drivande och resultatfokuserad, med en stark nyfikenhet på ny teknik. Du kan växla mellan att arbeta självständigt och i team, och du har ett gott självledarskap. Du håller ordning och reda, dokumenterar på en lagom nivå och bidrar till en kultur där man delar kunskap, utmanar gamla sanningar och tillsammans bygger smartare lösningar.
   

  

**Kontaktuppgifter:**
 Rekryterande chef: Poja Daroui, poja.daroui@agria.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Forena: Mirek Swartz, mirek.swartz@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: Ellinor Jatéus, ellinor.jateus@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

*Låter det spännande? Då vill vi veta mer om dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar löpande med denna rekrytering och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag.*
 Agria är ett helägt dotterbolag till Länsförsäkringar och finns idag i Sverige, Norge, Finland, Danmark, Storbritannien, Tyskland, Frankrike och Irland. Vårt svenska kontor ligger på Gärdet i Stockholm, men vårt hjärta och verksamhet sträcker sig långt utanför Sveriges gränser. Med en tydlig tillväxt agenda fortsätter vi att expandera internationellt, driva innovation och utveckla digitala lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för djurägare. Ett exempel är vårt dotterbolag Agria Vet Guide, som erbjuder digital rådgivning och gör det enklare att hjälpa fler djur snabbare.
   

  

 Vi är marknadsledande i Norden inom djur- och husdjursförsäkringar, med en tydlig vision: att bli Europas mest omtyckta och pålitliga partner för djurägare. Vårt ledarskap handlar inte bara om marknadsandelar; det handlar om att skapa trygghet för både djur och människor, och att göra livet med djur enklare och roligare.

title: Delteknikområdesansvarig inom cybersäkerhet
description:
Vill du bidra till att vår tekniska utveckling omsätts i konkret verksamhetsnytta? Vi söker en delteknikområdesansvarig som kan hålla ihop komplexa initiativ och skapa tydlighet, struktur och framdrift i samverkan mellan verksamhet, teknik och ledning.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
 Som delteknikområdesansvarig har du en sammanhållande roll i arbetet med att utveckla och förvalta tekniska lösningar över tid. Du verkar i gränslandet mellan verksamhetens behov, teknisk utveckling och organisationens övergripande mål, med fokus på både utveckling och långsiktig hållbarhet.
   

  

 Din uppgift är att skapa förutsättningar för att förvaltning och initiativ bedrivs genomförs på ett strukturerat sätt och att det finns en tydlig koppling mellan det vi behöver åstadkomma och det som faktiskt levereras.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att:
   

  

* samordna och hålla ihop komplexa leveranser som involverar flera verksamhets- och teknikområden
* omsätta övergripande mål och behov till tydliga leveransmål och prioriteringar
* skapa struktur för planering, uppföljning, kontinuitets- och riskhantering
* identifiera hinder, målkonflikter och beroenden samt säkerställa att dessa hanteras på rätt nivå
* skapa en samlad bild av status, framdrift, risker och behov av beslut
* säkerställa att relevanta frågor lyfts och bereds inför beslut
* bidra till att tekniska leveranser genomförs i linje med beslutade mål, strategier och prioriteringar
* följa upp att leveranser leder till avsedda förändringar och bidrar till den förväntade verksamhetsnyttan
* ingå i ledning och ansvara för våra tekniska leveranser på taktisk nivå genom nära samverkan med sektionschef, team, teknikområdesansvarig och verksamhet


 Rollen innebär att du behöver kunna röra dig mellan strategiska och operativa perspektiv. Ena stunden kan du behöva diskutera övergripande mål och prioriteringar med ledningen, och nästa stund hantera ett konkret beroende mellan två team.
   

  

**Vårt arbetssätt**
 Vi tror på tydliga roller och ett nära samarbete mellan verksamhet och teknik. Som ansvarig för den tekniska leveransen har du en viktig roll i att knyta ihop dessa perspektiv och skapa förutsättningar för att arbetet leder till konkreta resultat. Om du trivs i en varierande roll och motiveras av att skapa struktur i komplexa sammanhang, bygga samverkan och bidra till konkret verksamhetsnytta kan det här vara rollen för dig.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
**Vem är du?**
 Vi ser att du trivs i en roll där du får skapa struktur i komplexa sammanhang och driva utveckling tillsammans med andra. Med ett samordnande och strukturerat arbetssätt skapar du sammanhang mellan olika perspektiv och aktörer, samtidigt som du behåller helhetsperspektivet och ser hur olika delar hänger ihop.
   

  

 Du har ett drivande och ansvarstagande förhållningssätt och ser till att frågor förs framåt, blir hanterade och följs upp. Genom lyhördhet och god kommunikativ förmåga tar du in olika perspektiv, skapar delaktighet och bygger förtroendefulla relationer med människor på olika nivåer i organisationen.
   

  

 Med en tydlig och analytisk förmåga kan du kommunicera förväntningar, risker och beslut på ett begripligt sätt, samtidigt som du ser samband och kan bedöma konsekvenser. Du motiveras av att utveckla effektiva arbetssätt, skapa framdrift och bidra till långsiktiga resultat.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som har**
* universitets- eller högskoleutbildning inom IT om minst 180 hp, alternativt annan utbildning i kombination med erfarenhet som vi bedömer likvärdig
* flera års aktuell erfarenhet av tekniskt leveransansvar, exempelvis som produktägare, teknisk projektledare eller i en likvärdig roll
* vana att leda större eller komplexa utvecklings- och förändringsinitiativ
* goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift


**Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av**
* teknisk utveckling, digitalisering eller IT-förvaltning
* arbete i komplexa verksamhetsmiljöer med många beroenden mellan system, processer och leverantörer
* att följa upp resultat och säkerställa att leveranser skapar avsedd verksamhetsnytta
* eller förståelse för cybersäkerhet och IT-säkerhet, exempelvis riskhantering, kontinuitetshantering eller incidenthantering
* agila arbetssätt som SAFe, inklusive ansvar för backlogg, övergripande planering och prioritering av teamens sprintarbete


**Övrig information**
 Placeringsort för tjänsten är Borlänge, Göteborg, Stockholm eller Örebro.
   

  

 I denna rekrytering används webbaserade tester som en del i urvalet. Intervjuer är planerade att genomföras via skype vecka 46.
   

  

 Vill du ha en flexibel vardag med möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån? I den här rollen kan du jobba på distans upp till två dagar i veckan.
   

  

 För att undvika att du missar viktig information om din ansökan behöver du se till att hålla dig uppdaterad via "Min karriärsida"! Vi använder främst mail (från mejladress: noreply@heroma.se) för att göra utskick och kallelser. Kolla din inkorg och även skräppost/SPAM regelbundet under denna tid för att vara säker på att du får all information från oss! Du kan med fördel även lägga till den mejladressen i dina mejlkontakter.
   

  

**Ansökan**
 De frågor som du får besvara när du skickar in din ansökan kommer att ligga till grund för det första urvalet vi gör. Om det inte står något annat i annonsen vill vi att du bifogar ditt CV. Vi har slutat begära in personligt brev eftersom vi inte har med det som del av urvalsunderlaget. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du kontakta ansvarig chef för rekryteringen så att din ansökan blir hanterad enligt särskilda rutiner. Du hittar namn och kontaktuppgifter till chefen i annonsen.
   

  

 Inom vår IT-organisation är du med och utvecklar Sverige med hjälp av moderna och innovativa lösningar. Vi är mitt i en spännande förändring där vi försöker ta vara på digitaliseringens möjligheter till fullo. Digitaliseringen ställer allt större krav och vi vill därför anpassa oss vad gäller kompetens, arbetssätt och organisation i takt med utvecklingen. Vi har ett helhetsansvar för IT och telekom, en verksamhet som pågår dygnet runt, året om - precis som Sveriges transportsystem.
   

  

 På Trafikverket jobbar vi med att göra Sverige närmare. Vi tror på att en förening av olika erfarenheter, bakgrunder och perspektiv är den bästa grunden för att bygga en arbetsplats fri från diskriminering och en miljö där alla trivs och gör sitt bästa. Vi tror på mångfald där den gemensamma nämnaren är pålitlighet, engagemang och mod. För det är så vi bäst representerar vårt samhälle.

title: Experienced Specialist - Production IT Infrastructure & Security Support (Sweden)
description:
**Experienced Specialist – Production IT Infrastructure & Security Support (Sweden)**
 Are you an experienced Production IT (OT) Specialist with knowledge of Information Security and looking for your next challenge?
   

  

 At Arla, you will join a team focused on strengthening and maturing our Production Information Security posture across our end-to-end supply chain. Together, we will support, standardize and uplift Production IT solutions and security across our dairy sites.
   

  

 You will have responsibility for supporting and improving Production IT systems, helping our sites align with central security initiatives and meet evolving security requirements, including NIS2.
   

  

**How You Will Make An Impact**
 You will be part of our cross-regional OT Infrastructure Security & Support team, supporting dairy sites and working closely with colleagues across the organization.
   

  

 You will take the lead in driving and supporting IT security patching and maintenance plans, NIS2 requirements and related actions, IT security incident response, and standardization activities.
   

  

 Using your domain knowledge of OT infrastructure, networks, servers and client systems, you will work closely with site IT technicians, appointed business owners, and central infrastructure and security teams to continuously improve the business's OT infrastructure environment.
   

  

 You will coordinate with different departments and stakeholders to ensure alignment, provide recommendations and support the implementation of standards, security requirements and business continuity plans.
   

  

 The role is advertised as based in Solna, but the location is flexible. The successful candidate can be based at any of our dairy sites across Sweden.
   

  

 You should expect approximately 50% travel within Sweden, as regular presence at our dairy sites is an integral part of the role. The position requires a strong on-site presence while offering flexibility for a hybrid set-up of approximately 50%, depending on business and site needs.
   

  

 A company car will be provided, depending on location.
   

  

**What Will Make You Successful**
**Who you are**
 You are a strong communicator who can simplify complex technical and security topics for different audiences. You are comfortable working across functions, locations and cultures and have strong stakeholder management skills, enabling you to build trust and effective working relationships throughout the organization.
   

  

 You bring an analytical and structured approach to your work and are proactive in identifying opportunities for improvement. You take ownership of your responsibilities and have a strong continuous improvement mindset.
   

  

 You are comfortable working independently while being part of a cross-regional team and enjoy collaborating with both technical specialists and business stakeholders.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 To succeed in this role, we expect you to have
   

  

* A minimum of 5 years of experience within Production IT Infrastructure and Security, including areas such as server configuration, firewalls, server backup and redundancy solutions, or a strong background in FMCG OT production environments, implementation and maintenance.
* Knowledge of NIS2 and IEC 62443-3.
* Knowledge of designing, implementing and maintaining disaster recovery strategies.
* Experience in assessing risks and developing business continuity plans to help ensure critical operations can continue during disruptions.
* Experience working in multicultural environments.
* Full professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Swedish language skills are highly advantageous.
* A valid driving license.


 It would also be beneficial if you have
   

  

* A degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
* Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies, including Microsoft Azure DevOps and ServiceNow.
* Knowledge and experience with relevant hardware, systems, applications and standards, including
+ ESX, VMware/vSphere and Veeam.
+ Firewalls and security solutions such as Palo Alto/Panorama, Siemens and Windows Defender.
+ Active Directory and Vendor Access Management.
+ Network segmentation and communication, including VLANs, routing and IP mapping.
+ Managed switches and networking technologies, including Cisco, Mellanox and Siemens.


**What We Offer**
 At Arla Foods, we are committed to creating the conditions for a sustainable work life. Through our flexible working model, Power of the Mix, we combine the benefits of office collaboration with the flexibility of remote work, balancing the needs of both the business and our employees.
   

  

 We are equally committed to helping our people grow. You'll have opportunities to develop your professional skills, take on new challenges, and build your career within a collaborative and supportive international organization. Our culture is built on trust, cooperation, and a shared ambition to make a meaningful impact.
   

  

 By joining Arla, you'll become part of a market-leading dairy company and a farmer-owned cooperative, producing trusted household brands enjoyed by millions every day. Together, we strive to create nutritious products and sustainable solutions that make a positive difference for our customers, our owners, and society as a whole.
   

  

 Arla Foods has collective agreements, and we always ensure to offer good and competitive working conditions. In addition to that, safety and working environment are our top priorities, which is why we, among other things, conduct random drug and alcohol tests.
   

  

**Create the Future. Grow with Arla.**
**Application**
 If you want to drive growth and help shape the industry, then seize this exciting opportunity. Please apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-09-23. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Important Upload your CV in English. Please note that we are not able to process any applications sent by email, due to GDPR regulations. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes.
   

  

 If you have questions or would like more information about the position, please contact Hiring Manager Nathan Hill (Manager - Head of IT Product IT&Digital Foundation OT Infrastructure), nathi@arlafoods.com.If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact Hannah Lagerstedt, Talent Acquisition Partner, hannah.lagerstedt@arlafoods.com.
   

  

**Shape the Future of Dairy**
 Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

title: Senior konsult AI Engineering & Modern AI | Technology Consulting | Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 Vill du hjälpa några av Nordens mest spännande organisationer att skapa verkligt affärsvärde med hjälp av AI och data?

 AI & Data är ett snabbt växande och prioriterat område inom EY Technology Consulting. Vi söker en senior konsult med erfarenhet av AI Engineering och modern AI-utveckling som vill hjälpa organisationer att skapa värde med nästa generations AI-lösningar. **Egenskaper för att lyckas i rollen**
 Du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och motiveras av att omsätta ny teknik till affärsvärde. Du trivs i en konsultroll där du kombinerar teknisk problemlösning med kunddialog. **Vad vi erbjuder dig**
 På EY kommer vi att hjälpa dig utveckla och anpassa dina färdigheter framåt utifrån en upplevelse i världsklass. Vi stärker dig i en flexibel miljö och låter dig och din kompetens blomma i en kultur som värdesätter mångfald och inkludering på en global nivå. Läs mer här Careers at EY | EY - Global.
   

  

**Är du redo att “Shape your future with confidence”?** 
**Ansök idag.**
 Vänligen skicka in din ansökan senast den
 **11 oktober 2026.** 
 Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Vid frågor gällande tjänsten kontakta Fredrik Sannergren på Fredrik.Sannergren@se.ey.com. Vid frågor gällande rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta Adrian Lyng på Adrian.Lyng@se.ey.com. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse.
 *Observera att en bakgrundskontroll kommer att genomföras som en del av rekryteringsprocessen.*
 På EY främjar vi en inkluderande miljö och värdesätter olikheter. Vi uppmuntrar ansökningar från kandidater med olika bakgrunder och strävar efter en rättvis rekryteringsprocess. Vid behov av stöd eller anpassningar, kontakta vårt rekryteringsteam på recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com.
   

  

**EY | Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Full Stack Engineer - Monetization
description:
**Join our global force of 400+ innovators, blending the latest in tech with the greatest in soundtracking, from our Stockholm HQ to offices in London, New York, Los Angeles, Berlin, Paris, Oslo, and Seoul. We’re an industry leader with a startup mentality. We take what we do seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Creating and collaborating to transform the sound of streaming, content, and culture. Come join us, and let the world
 *feel* 
 your work** 




  





 As a Full Stack Engineer on our Monetization team, you'll help shape how millions of users discover and choose the Epidemic Sound plan that's right for them. Monetization owns everything from subscriptions and upsells to credit top-ups and add-ons - and we run on experimentation, testing hypotheses with real A/B tests.
 



 You'll join two experienced full stack engineers on the team, working across the stack to ship new features and drive the adoption of our new backend. It's a role with real architectural scope: you'll help shape decisions on both the front end and back end as we build new features and retire legacy systems, all while working closely with the business leads who depend on what we build.
 



  





**Your Key Responsibilities Include** 



* Writing production-ready code across the back end and front end-stable, well-tested, and built to last - to ship new features and advance our technical strategy
* Reviewing code thoughtfully for engineers across the team and beyond
* Participating in and leading technical discoveries, working through problems collaboratively rather than in isolation
* Partnering closely with a Product Manager to build a deep understanding of the product
* Sharing in a company-wide on-call rotation (frequency is flexible)

title: Tech Lead inom AI och agentisk mjukvaruutveckling
description:
**Vill du vara med och forma hur framtidens AI-baserade system för försvar och säkerhet ska utvecklas? Har du djup teknisk kompetens inom modern mjukvaruutveckling och AI och förmågan att omsätta en snabbt föränderlig teknikfront till konkreta tekniska vägval? Vi söker en Tech Lead som får en central roll i att utveckla vår tekniska förmåga inom AI-native och agentisk mjukvaruutveckling.**
**På FOI får du arbeta nära både forskning och avancerad systemutveckling och tillsammans med skickliga forskare och ingenjörer skapa nya förmågor för Sveriges försvar och säkerhet.**
**Om tjänsten**
 Som Tech Lead har du ett övergripande tekniskt ansvar för ett team som arbetar med rapid prototyping och utveckling av avancerade AI-baserade informationssystem. Din huvudsakliga uppgift är att hålla samman och utveckla teamets tekniska riktning. Du följer utvecklingen inom AI och mjukvaruutveckling, identifierar relevanta tekniksprång och omsätter dem i tekniska strategier, långsiktiga mål och prioriteringar.
   

  

 Du arbetar nära teamets forskningsingenjörer, som självständigt driver tekniska idéer, experiment och utvecklingsarbete. Din roll är inte att detaljstyra deras tekniska arbete, utan att skapa en gemensam riktning och säkerställa att teamet över tid bygger upp rätt tekniska förmågor. En central del av uppdraget är att utveckla hur teamet arbetar med AI-native mjukvaruutveckling. Tillsammans med teamet utforskar och etablerar du nya arbetssätt med bland annat generativ AI, coding agents och agentiska utvecklingsmiljöer. Du är samtidigt själv tekniskt aktiv. Genom prototyper, proof-of-concepts och tekniska experiment undersöker du nya tekniker, prövar arkitekturidéer och skapar underlag för strategiska teknikval. Du håller samman övergripande arkitekturprinciper och tekniska vägval och fungerar som tekniskt bollplank och mentor för teamets forskningsingenjörer. I rollen representerar du även teamets tekniska perspektiv i samarbeten både inom och utanför FOI. Du har inget personalansvar.
   

  

  

**Din bakgrund**
**Vi Söker Dig Som Har**
* relevant akademisk examen inom exempelvis datateknik, informationsteknik, teknisk fysik eller motsvarande kompetens som vi bedömer likvärdig
* gedigen erfarenhet av kvalificerad mjukvaru- och systemutveckling
* mycket god programmeringsförmåga och förmåga att själv arbeta hands-on i komplexa system
* erfarenhet av att ta övergripande tekniskt ansvar för komplexa mjukvarusystem, större utvecklingsområden eller tekniska plattformar
* erfarenhet av tekniskt ledarskap, exempelvis som Tech Lead, Staff/Principal Engineer, Lead Developer, Software Architect eller motsvarande
* förmåga att formulera teknisk strategi och omsätta långsiktiga mål till konkreta prioriteringar och vägval
* praktisk erfarenhet av AI-baserad mjukvaruutveckling där AI-modeller, generativ AI och coding agents utgör centrala delar av systemen och utvecklingsarbetet.


 Du behöver kunna uttrycka dig väl på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
   

  

  

**Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av**
* att bygga upp eller långsiktigt utveckla teknisk förmåga i en teknisk organisation
* AI-native software engineering, coding agents och agentic development workflows
* agentiska eller multi-agentbaserade AI-system
* rapid prototyping och forskningsnära eller experimentell systemutveckling
* arkitektur för system som kombinerar LLM:er, andra AI-modeller, data, verktyg och externa system
* evaluation av generativa och agentiska AI-system
* försvars-, säkerhets- eller andra komplexa och säkerhetskritiska system.


**Vem är du?**
 Du kombinerar tekniskt djup med förmågan att se längre än den lösning som behöver byggas idag. Du är nyfiken på ny teknik men inte okritisk – du kan skilja mellan sådant som är tillfälligt intressant och teknik som faktiskt kan förändra hur vi arbetar eller vilka system vi kan skapa. Du trivs med att arbeta tillsammans med andra mycket kompetenta ingenjörer och forskare. Du ser tekniskt ledarskap som något annat än detaljstyrning. Du skapar riktning genom teknisk trovärdighet, goda resonemang och förmågan att få andra att bidra till gemensamma vägval.
   

  

 Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
   

  

  

**Vad erbjuder vi dig?**
 Totalförsvarets forskningsinstitut (FOI) är en statlig myndighet som bedriver världsledande forskning inom försvar och säkerhet till stöd för Sveriges militära och civila försvar. Vi erbjuder en unik arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att arbeta med det som är viktigt för totalförsvaret och hela samhället. Forskningen tillämpas både inom försvarsmyndigheter och hos civila aktörer och spelar en avgörande roll i att bygga en relevant och effektiv försvarsförmåga.
   

  

 Vi arbetar medvetet för en god arbetsmiljö med en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Utöver detta erbjuder vi en rad förmåner. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss: https://www.foi.se/jobba-hos-oss.html
   

  

 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning. Alla chefer på FOI har en tillsvidaretjänst i verksamheten. Vi tillämpar chefsförordnande som avtalas på tre år med möjlighet till förlängning.
   

  

  

**Vill du vara med och söka svaren för en säkrare värld?**
 Välkommen med din ansökan i form av CV och personligt brev på svenska via ansökningsknappen senast den
   

**25 oktober!**
 För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta
   

**Verksamhetsområdeschef Mikael Jangelind**
 . Fackliga företrädare är David Sundell (Saco-S) och Lisa Bergsten (OFR/S – ST).
   

**Samtliga nås på 08-555 030 00.**
 Då anställningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585). Inför säkerhetsprövning efterfrågas vidimerade kopior på de utbildningar och tjänstgöringsintyg som är relevanta för tjänsten.

title: Partner Solutions Architect
description:
Job title: Partner Solutions Architect
 



 Job location: Stockholm, Sweden
 



 Job ID: 136330
 



  





**Own Every Moment at NetApp** 




 At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.
 



 Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 You'll help partners become self-sufficient technical engines of growth.
 



 As a Partner Solutions Architect (PSA), you will be a technical leader responsible for scaling NetApp's technical reach through the partner ecosystem. Acting as a trusted advisor to strategic reseller, distributor, and alliance partners, you will build partner capability, shape technical strategy, and enable partners to independently position, architect, sell, and deliver NetApp solutions
 



 Working closely with partners, field sales, systems engineers, alliance teams, and product organisations, you will bridge technical enablement and business execution. Through coaching, solution leadership, community development, and thought leadership, you will accelerate partner maturity, expand portfolio adoption, and drive measurable partner-led growth. Success in this role comes from influence, enablement, and scale rather than direct ownership of customer opportunities.
 



 The PSA operates through coaching, mentoring, and capability development rather than direct execution. The goal is to help partners become increasing self-sufficent, reducing dependency on NetApp whilst increasing their ability to independently create customer and business growth.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Build Partner Capability** 




 Own the technical enablement strategy for assigned partners, aligned to business priorities and growth objectives. Develop partner technical maturity across NetApp's strategic solution portfolios through scalable workshops, bootcamps, hands-on labs, technical onboarding programmes, and coaching initiatives. Mentor partner Solution Architects, Systems Engineers, and technical leaders to build long-term capability and independence. Enable distributor technical teams to autonomously qualify, design, and support opportunities within their market segments.
 



  





**Provide Technical Solution Leadership** 




 Provide architecture guidance on complex partner-led opportunities and act as a technical escalation point when additional expertise is required. Help partners develop differentiated, domain-led offerings that integrate NetApp technologies into broader customer solutions and alliance ecosystems. Support solution validation, design reviews, and the development of repeatable solution patterns that partners can independently replicate and scale. Guide and coach partners through technical decision-making, helping them to build confidence and capability to lead future engagements independently.
 



  





**Evangelise and Lead Thought Leadership** 




 Present at bootcamps, partner conferences, technical communities, distributor events, and industry forums. Build credibility and influence through technical leadership and community engagement. Contribute to technical content, reference architectures, best-practice guidance, and reusable enablement materials that strengthen the broader partner ecosystem.
 



  





**Grow the Partner Community** 




 Build and nurture strong relationships within partner and distributor organisations. Develop thriving technical communities, advisory groups, and peer networks that encourage knowledge sharing and collaboration. Connect partner practice leaders with NetApp experts and foster collaboration across partners, distributors, alliance teams, and field organisations.
 



  





**Accelerate Partner-Led Growth** 




 Collaborate with sales, channel, marketing, and alliance teams to drive partner-led pipeline creation and portfolio expansion. Support partner-led campaigns, workshops, technical events, and solution development initiatives that help partners identify, qualify, and progress opportunities independently. Increase adoption across NetApp's strategic portfolio areas and help partners expand beyond traditional storage opportunities.
 



  





**Connect Ecosystem Insights to Strategy** 




 Act as a voice of the partner ecosystem within NetApp by capturing partner and customer feedback and helping influence technical strategy and future solutions. Share market insights, partner challenges, and emerging opportunities with internal stakeholders to improve partner success and solution relevance.
 



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Significant experience in technical presales, solution architecture, consulting, partner enablement, or related technical leadership roles.
* Experience working with channel partners, distributors, system integrators, or alliance partners.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise IT, cloud, data infrastructure, and solution architecture practices.
* Experience aligning technical strategy and enablement programmes to commercial and business priorities.
* Experience developing technical capability through coaching, enablement programmes, mentoring, or community leadership.
* Familiarity with hyperscaler cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud) and alliance technologies such as Cisco, NVIDIA, and Commvault.
* Ability to translate technical differentiation into repeatable partner-led solutions and business outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and influencing skills.
* Ability to drive outcomes through expertise and collaboration rather than direct authority.
* A coaching mindset and a passion for helping others succeed.
* Ability to thrive in a matrix organisation and balance strategic thinking with practical execution.


- 


**Nice to Have** 



* Experience in a technical role within a sales, channel, or alliance organisation.
* Experience building and scaling technical communities and enablement programmes.
* Experience creating technical content, such as blogs, whitepapers, workshops, or conference sessions.
* Familiarity with AI infrastructure, cyber resilience, hybrid cloud, or other modern data infrastructure architectures.
* Experience working across multiple countries, partner ecosystems, or alliances.



  





 At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 




 NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.
 



  





**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp** 




 At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
 



 NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.
 



  





**Our culture** 




 We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.
 



 If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.
 



  





**Submitting an Application**

This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.

title: Thesis Worker 30 hp - Integrating Wear and Sensor information
description:
**30 hp – Integrating Wear and Sensor information to predict Remaining Useful Life using Data-driven methods**  

  

  

**Introduction**  

  

Thesis work is an excellent way to get closer to Scania and build relationships for the future. Many of today's employees began their Scania career with their degree project.  



  

  

**Background**  

  



TRATON GROUP is one of the world’s leading commercial vehicle manufacturers, with brands including Scania, MAN, International and Volkswagen Truck & Bus. Its portfolio covers light commercial vehicles, trucks and buses, complemented by financing, charging and digital logistics services. Through its global operations, production sites and extensive sales and service networks, TRATON has access to diverse vehicle platforms, real-world operational data and fleet deployment environments. This provides a strong foundation for developing and validating innovative solutions for sustainable and efficient transportation.


In the Cloud and Embedded Plattform domain within TRATON, we develop new solutions for connected vehicles in our Internet of Things (IoT) platform, as part of TRATON’s increasing focus on communication, services and smart transport solutions. Advanced data analysis capabilities are a cornerstone enabler in this development.

  

  

**Target/scope**  

  



Modern connected vehicles and industrial systems are increasingly equipped with sensors that continuously monitor their condition. This enables a shift from reactive to predictive maintenance, where decisions are based on the expected Remaining Useful Life (RUL) of components.


RUL prediction relies on two complementary information sources: wear factors, which describe accumulated degradation through usage and operating conditions, and sensor factors, which reflect the current observed state of the system.


Our recent work [1] proposes a probabilistic framework that combines these two sources using a survival-based aging model and a data-driven model, enabling not only RUL estimation but also associated prediction uncertainty.


The objective of this thesis is to implement and extend this framework, and to investigate how different modelling and uncertainty quantification choices affect RUL prediction performance and reliability.

  

  

  

**Job description**  

  



The thesis will investigate probabilistic fusion of wear-based and sensor-based models for Remaining Useful Life prediction. This work will include:


* Reproduce and validate the proposed framework: Implement and evaluate the approach presented in [1], including the survival-based aging model, neural-network-based RUL model, and their probabilistic combination.
* Explore alternative modelling approaches: Investigate alternatives to the Weibull survival model and/or neural-network architecture used in [1]. Evaluate how different modelling assumptions influence RUL prediction and uncertainty.
* Evaluate generalisation across datasets: Test the framework on additional datasets and operating conditions to study its robustness and ability to generalise beyond the original experimental setting.
* Investigate uncertainty quantification for RUL prediction: Compare different approaches for estimating predictive uncertainty and study their effect on the resulting RUL distributions, prediction intervals, calibration and accuracy.
  

If time permits, investigate extensions that relax the proxy assumption used in the data-generating formulation in [1], with the aim of developing a more general relationship between wear, latent component health, sensor observations, and failure.


The thesis provides an opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, survival analysis, uncertainty quantification and predictive maintenance, with both methodological research questions and applications to real-world industrial systems.

  

  

  

**Reference**  

  



[1] Srinivasan, Abhishek, et al. "Integrating Survival-Based Aging Models with Data-Driven RUL Prognostics." PHM Society European Conference. Vol. 9. No. 1. 2026.  

  

  

  



**Education/line/direction**  

  

  



Masters programmes in Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Science, Complex Adaptive Systems or similar.


Number of students: 1


Start date for the Thesis project: Spring 2027

description:
**30 hp – Conformal Prediction for Counterfactual Generation**  

  

  



**Introduction**  

  



Thesis work is an excellent way to get closer to Scania and build relationships for the future. Many of today's employees began their Scania career with their degree project.

  

  

  

**Background**  

  



TRATON GROUP is one of the world’s leading commercial vehicle manufacturers, with brands including Scania, MAN, International and Volkswagen Truck & Bus. Its portfolio covers light commercial vehicles, trucks and buses, complemented by financing, charging and digital logistics services. Through its global operations, production sites and extensive sales and service networks, TRATON has access to diverse vehicle platforms, real-world operational data and fleet deployment environments. This provides a strong foundation for developing and validating innovative solutions for sustainable and efficient transportation.


In the Cloud and embedded department within TRATON, we develop new solutions for connected vehicles in our Internet of Things (IoT) platform, as part of TRATON’s increasing focus on communication, services and smart transport solutions. Advanced data analysis capabilities are a cornerstone enabler in this development.

  

  

**Target/scope**  

  



Modern connected vehicles and industrial systems are increasingly equipped with sensors that continuously monitor their condition. The increasing availability of such data enables data-driven models, for example anomaly detection models, to identify abnormal system behaviour and support monitoring and maintenance decisions.


However, many high-performing machine-learning models are inherently difficult to interpret. While a model may identify a sample as anomalous, the prediction itself does not necessarily explain why the sample is considered anomalous or what would need to change for it to be considered normal.


Counterfactual explanations provide one approach to addressing this problem. A counterfactual describes how an input could be modified to obtain a different model prediction. However, counterfactuals are commonly generated through optimization, and a generated counterfactual may therefore achieve the desired prediction while being unrealistic or lying far from the distribution represented by real data.


Conformal prediction provides a model-agnostic framework for quantifying uncertainty with statistical guarantees and offers an interesting direction for addressing this problem. Recent work has investigated the connection between conformal prediction and counterfactual explanations [1].


The objective of this thesis is to investigate how conformal prediction can be used to validate plausible counterfactual explanations for anomaly detection, and to study under which assumptions meaningful statistical guarantees can be provided.  

  

  

  



**Job description**

  

The thesis will investigate methods for generating counterfactual explanations with conformal guarantees. The work will include:  

  

  



* Implement a baseline anomaly detection framework: Implement or adapt an existing anomaly detection model and establish datasets and evaluation procedures for the thesis.
* Implement baseline counterfactual methods: Generate counterfactual explanations using one or more established approaches and evaluate their ability to produce valid, proximal, and plausible counterfactuals.
* Develop conformal counterfactual methods: Investigate how conformal prediction can be incorporated into counterfactual generation or filtering. Explore alternative nonconformity measures and strategies for determining whether generated counterfactuals are supported by the observed data distribution.
* Evaluate counterfactual quality and conformal guarantees: Systematically evaluate the generated counterfactuals in terms of properties such as validity, proximity, sparsity, plausibility and conformal coverage/validity. Study the trade-offs between producing counterfactuals close to the original observation and counterfactuals that are well supported by representative data.
* Investigate robustness and generalization: Evaluate the proposed methods across different anomaly detection models, datasets, and/or data distributions to understand when the conformal guarantees and generated explanations remain reliable.
  

The thesis provides an opportunity to work at the intersection of explainable AI, anomaly detection, optimization and uncertainty quantification, while addressing the fundamental question:


How can counterfactual explanations be generated that are statistically supported by the data?  

  

  

  



**Reference**  

  



[1] Maalej, Aicha, Cecilia Sönströd, and Ulf Johansson. "Counterfactual explanations for conformal prediction sets." Proceedings of Machine Learning Research 266 (2025): 1-20.

description:
**30 hp - Adaptive Hierarchical Inference with Foundation models for Commercial-Vehicle Edge-Cloud Systems**

  

**Introduction**

  

Thesis work is an excellent way to get closer to Scania and build relationships for the future. Many of today's employees began their Scania career with their degree project.

  

**Background**

  

TRATON GROUP is one of the world’s leading commercial vehicle manufacturers. Its brands include Scania, MAN, International and Volkswagen Truck & Bus. The group offers light commercial vehicles, trucks and buses, supported by financing, charging and digital logistics services. Through its global operations, production sites, and sales and service networks, TRATON has access to diverse vehicle platforms, real-world data and fleet environments. This provides a strong basis for developing and validating solutions for more sustainable and efficient transportation.

  

Within TRATON’s Cloud and Embedded Platform department, we develop solutions for connected vehicles and IoT platforms. This work supports TRATON’s growing focus on communication, digital services and smart transport. Advanced data analysis is an important part of these developments. Modern commercial vehicles generate diverse data from vehicle telemetry, time-series sensors, cameras, radar, LiDAR and operational logs. High-performance units and embedded platforms make it possible to process much of this data close to the vehicle, reducing latency, network dependence and unnecessary data transfer. Foundation models could support predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, diagnostic assistance, multimodal perception and reasoning. However, the most capable models require cloud-scale computing resources, while onboard systems face strict limits on computation, memory, energy and communication. This research therefore focuses on hierarchical inference. A compact model performs real-time analysis onboard, while a larger cloud-based model is used only when the local prediction is uncertain and the latency and resource conditions allow it.

  

**Objective**  

  

The objective is to design and evaluate an uncertainty-aware, adaptive inference cascade across sensing or embedded devices, a vehicle high-performance unit (HPU), and cloud resources. The focus of the work will be on efficient inference, confidence estimation, and orchestration rather than on development of foundation models. The problem definition of the thesis is: How can calibrated uncertainty and vehicle operating conditions be used to decide, per input, whether a compact onboard model should answer locally or defer to a larger model, while meeting task-quality and latency requirements and limiting communication and resource use?

  

Together with the supervisors, the student will select one representative commercial-vehicle use case, such as predictive maintenance or anomaly detection, visual diagnostic assistance, time-series reasoning, or multimodal situational awareness. To keep the 20-week scope feasible, the thesis should prioritize one use case, one main data modality (or a clearly defined multimodal pair), and one primary algorithmic contribution: calibrated uncertainty and adaptive cloud escalation. The primary scope is the vehicle HPU-to-cloud cascade; sensor-level processing may be included only when it directly supports the chosen use case. The exact data, models, and target hardware will be defined based on availability and confidentiality requirements.

  

Illustrative three-tier deployment concept


(The focus will most likely be on Tier 2 and 3; Tier 1 is mentioned for context)

Primary purpose

  

  

Tier 1: Sensor / Embedded layer

  

Lightweight preprocessing or tiny agent; signal-quality and uncertainty indicators

  

Reduce data, detect degraded sensing, and prepare features for onboard inference

  

  

Tier 2: Vehicle HPU layer

Low-latency local inference with a


or uncertainty score

  

  

Tier 3: Cloud layer

  

Large specialized or multimodal foundation model

  

Enhanced reasoning for difficult cases when latency, connectivity, and policy permit

  

  

  

  

**Job description**  

  



* Conduct a literature study on compact foundation models, hierarchical inference, uncertainty estimation and calibration, learning to defer, and adaptive resource aware edge-cloud offloading.
* Select and deploy a compact open-source model on a representative edge or HPU platform. Characterize model quality, latency, throughput, memory footprint, model size, and, where feasible, energy consumption.
* Implement and evaluate a confidence or uncertainty-estimation method for the local model.
* Develop an adaptive threshold-learning or cloud-escalation strategy that jointly considers uncertainty, task quality, and other relevant factors such as latency and operational cost.
* Compare local-only, remote-only, static-threshold, adaptive-routing, and retrospective-oracle baselines. Report repeated trials and uncertainty for task quality, calibration, offload rate, latency, communication, memory, and energy where feasible.
* Deliver reproducible code, experiment configurations, documented datasets and models, analysis scripts, and a clear account of limitations and deployment assumptions.
An optional extension is a theoretical performance model, regret analysis, or a clearly scoped multimodal experiment.

  

**Expected outcome**

  

  

The expected result is a reproducible prototype and evaluation pipeline that combines an edge-deployable foundation model, calibrated uncertainty estimates, and an adaptive escalation policy. Subject to result quality and confidentiality constraints, the work may also contribute to a scientific publication.


References


[1] V. N. Moothedath, J. P. Champati, and J. Gross, "Getting the Best Out of Both Worlds: Algorithms for Hierarchical Inference at the Edge," IEEE Transactions on Machine Learning in Communications and Networking, 2024.


[2] C.-H. Chang, A. P. Behera, S. Zhang Pettersson, and J. Gross, "A Cost-Aware Hierarchical Cascade for Anomaly Detection at the Edge in Connected Vehicles," ACM/IEEE Symposium on Edge Computing, 2025.


[3] Z. Liu et al., "MobileLLM: Optimizing Sub-billion Parameter Language Models for On-Device Use Cases," ICML 2024. https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.14905

Master's programmes in Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a similar field. Strong Python skills and experience with a deep-learning framework are expected. Familiarity with foundation-model inference, uncertainty estimation or calibration, embedded or edge platforms, multimodal or time-series learning, or performance profiling is beneficial.

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

**Purpose of Role**


We are creating a new senior role to partner directly with our Chief Customer Officer (CCO) in transforming a post-sales organisation of roughly 140 people across Support, Carrier Integration, and Professional Services, spanning multiple European geographies.


This is not a coordination or reporting role. Given how dispersed the organisation is, this person's presence in our offices — running workshops, working alongside teams, building solutions on the ground — is itself part of how we bring the CCO's leadership closer to the frontline. The role exists to personally own and deliver our highest-priority transformation initiatives, not to track them.

**Please note that this is not a leadership role**

**Overall Responsibility**


The (Senior) Director Of Post Sales Operationsto the CCO will lead the hands-on delivery of transformation initiatives across the post-sales organisation, reporting to the Chief Customer Officer. This is an execution-first role: leading workshops, building AI-enabled tools and workflows, and driving initiatives from idea through to working reality, in close partnership with functional leaders across Support, Carrier Integration, and Professional Services. Frequent travel across our European offices is expected and central to how this role operates.

**Competence and Experience**


The area of responsibility includes:

**Hands-On Transformation Leadership**

* Personally lead and deliver the CCO's highest-priority transformation initiatives across Support, Carrier Integration, and Professional Services, from design through to execution.
* Run and facilitate working sessions and workshops directly with functional leaders and frontline teams to design new ways of working.
* Take initiatives from idea to built reality, working alongside the teams doing the work rather than directing from a distance.

**AI Fluency & Building**

* Bring genuine, hands-on AI fluency: able to build or prototype AI-enabled workflows, tools, or automations that remove friction from post-sales operations.
* Identify where AI and automation can accelerate transformation across the three functions, and personally help stand up early solutions rather than only scoping them for others.

**Cross-Functional Execution**

* Translate the CCO's strategic priorities into concrete, deliverable initiatives that span more than one of the three functions.
* Actively manage cross-functional handoffs and dependencies so initiatives land, not just get tracked.
* Represent the CCO in forums and decisions where direct involvement isn't required.

**Frontline Presence & Stakeholder Management**

* Spend significant time in person across our European offices, bringing visible leadership presence to a highly dispersed team.
* Build genuine, trusted working relationships with functional leaders and frontline staff across Support, Carrier Integration, and Professional Services.
* Support internal talent development and act as a connector between frontline teams and the executive team.

**Key Requirements**

**Experience & Background**

* 10+ years in senior post-sales, customer operations, or transformation leadership roles within B2B SaaS, ideally spanning more than one of: Support, Professional Services, Customer Success, or Partner/Integration functions.
* A demonstrated track record of personally building things — an AI-enabled tool, an automated workflow, a from-scratch operating model, or similar — not just directing others to build them.
* Experience leading hands-on transformation or operating-model change, including running workshops and driving execution to completion.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity, building structure where none exists yet, without waiting for a fully-formed mandate.
* Experience navigating senior leadership environments and translating complex operational issues into clear, actionable decisions.

**Skills & Attributes**

* Genuine, hands-on AI fluency — comfortable building or prototyping with AI tools, not just directing others to.
* Strong facilitation skills; able to run a workshop and drive a room to a decision.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to distil complexity into clear, direct recommendations.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

**Behaviours & Competencies**

* Builder mindset: prefers doing to directing, and delivering to reporting.
* Structured, decisive, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment.
* Genuinely willing to travel frequently across our European offices — this role is defined by frontline presence, not remote coordination.
* Collaborative, low-ego partner to functional leaders across Support, Carrier Integration, and Professional Services.

**Why This Role Matters**


A post-sales organisation this dispersed doesn't transform through dashboards and steering committees alone — it transforms when someone senior enough to matter is in the room, building the solution alongside the team that has to live with it. This role brings that presence and that capability directly into the CCO's leadership, turning strategic priorities into things that actually get built.
