title: Engineering Manager - Simulation within Autonomous Technologies
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Want to be part of transforming road freight? Einride is showing the world a new way to move, based on the latest digital, autonomous and electric technologies. We build the technology that hauls freight efficiently, and we put it to work for the world's leading manufacturers, retailers, logistics providers and defense organizations, all working toward a future where moving goods costs less for our customers, and less for the planet.



Founded in 2016, Einride became the first company in the world to deploy a cab-less autonomous electric vehicle on a public road (Sweden, 2019). In 2022, we were the first to successfully operate such a vehicle on a U.S. public road. In June 2026, Einride became a publicly listed company on Nasdaq, a milestone that reflects a decade of turning what once looked like science fiction into everyday reality. Today, our technology moves freight across North America, Europe, and the Middle East for some of the world's biggest shippers.



We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Simulation team. Your mission is to make simulation the primary way Einride develops and validates its autonomous driving system, in a future where the driving stack is heavily ML-driven. Your team builds and operates the simulation infrastructure the whole organization depends on: the platforms, tooling, compute, and pipelines that let ML, planning, and controls engineers iterate quickly, and that give V&V a foundation they can trust. You will set the technical direction for that infrastructure, decide where to build and where to partner, and grow the team's depth in core simulation as we scale our capabilities for our next-generation vehicle.


### **You will:**


* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing engineering team focused on simulation infrastructure and platform engineering.
* Architect, scale, and operate the closed-loop simulation platform and pipelines that let teams across the organization author scenarios, run high-fidelity sensor models, and execute SIL and HIL testing, with the reliability and throughput development and V&V depend on.
* Set the technical direction for the simulation stack: evaluate and integrate commercial, open-source, and in-house components, make build-vs-partner decisions, and prepare the architecture for ML-driven approaches such as neural reconstruction and generative world models.
* Treat simulation as an internal product: gather requirements from your users, prioritize the roadmap, and measure success by adoption, iteration speed, and trust in results.
* Build the tooling and data flows that connect virtual testing with real-world vehicle testing, so teams can compare, correlate, and trace results across both.
* Lead the engineering team and the wider organization through the transition toward simulation-driven development.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional leadership across Perception, Motion Planning & Control, Systems Engineering, and Verification & Validation (V&V).


### **We expect you to have:**


* Proven track record of building and leading teams delivering platform/infra products in autonomous driving, robotics, or complex safety-critical domains.
* Solid understanding of closed-loop simulation for dev/validation, including fidelity trade-offs (scenario, object, and sensor level).
* Hands-on experience with large-scale sim infrastructure (cloud/on-prem orchestration, CI/CD, data pipelines, containerization).
* Familiarity with modern ML-driven simulation/eval (neural reconstruction, generative world models, real-world data replay).
* User-centric approach to internal teams, prioritizing roadmaps based on impact and navigating build-vs-partner decisions.
* Strong capability to guide technical experts and foster excellence across organizational boundaries

 **Meriting experience:**

* Hands-on experience with autonomous-driving or robotics simulation platforms, for example NVIDIA's simulation ecosystem (AlpaSim, NuRec, Cosmos, Omniverse) or comparable commercial and open-source tools.
* Experience running simulation at scale, such as GPU compute orchestration, large batch and replay workloads in CI/CD, and optimizing for throughput and cost.
* Experience leading teams that build simulation infrastructure or internal developer platforms, serving both development and V&V users.
* Background in autonomous vehicles, robotics, aerospace, or another safety-critical domain.



This is a full-time position based in Stockholm or Gothenburg. We recommend that you submit your application as soon as possible since selection and interviews are held continually.



Please note that as part of our standard recruitment process, we conduct a background control on the final candidate for this role. This may include verification of education, employment history, any relevant professional certifications or other information that may be of our interest.

**Company Description**
-----------------------

  

Born autonomous. Born electric.



Since 2016, our technology has connected global communities with the things they need – and all without the emissions. We’re made up of experts in multiple fields and that’s how we’ve developed a new way to move goods. This is technology purpose-built for the industry. This is safer, cleaner, and more reliable movement.



We are Einride and this is how we build a better future.

title: Applied Machine Learning Lead
description:
Position Overview The Applied Machine Learning Lead is a senior, hands-on role responsible for ensuring Data Science and Machine Learning initiatives deliver measurable business value. The role combines product ownership, roadmap management, advanced analytics, production-ready machine learning engineering, experimentation ownership, technical standards, and deep iGaming expertise. The focus is on identifying high-value opportunities, prioritising initiatives, delivering robust and scalable data science solutions, evaluating outcomes, and driving adoption of data-driven decision-making across the business. Success in this role is measured not only by model performance, but by the impact those models have on player behaviour, commercial outcomes, product performance, and the ability of the Data Science function to deliver reliable, reusable, and scalable solutions.
  
  

Key Responsibilities Lead and perform advanced commercial and business-focused analyses to support strategic decision-making. Design, build, deploy, and maintain production-grade statistical and machine learning models, applying software engineering best practices to improve maintainability, reliability, testing, observability, and speed from experimentation to production. Own the end-to-end experimentation lifecycle, from hypothesis definition and experiment design through implementation, validation, analysis, interpretation, and iterative optimisation. Ensure analytical recommendations and model outcomes are grounded in statistically sound methods and commercially meaningful results.
  
  

Review, validate, and challenge analytical work, experiments, and machine learning models to ensure technical correctness, robustness, scalability, and business relevance. Own and manage the data science backlog and roadmap, prioritising work in collaboration with stakeholders Translate complex business problems into well-scoped initiatives with clear objectives, success criteria, and measurable outcomes. Provide technical leadership on modelling approaches, feature engineering, validation methods, experimentation design, deployment practices, and continuous improvement of machine learning solutions Develop reusable machine learning capabilities, analytical workflows, and technical standards to improve quality, consistency, scalability, and efficiency across the Data Science function. Establish and promote standards for model review, documentation, feature engineering, validation, testing, monitoring, and production readiness.
  
  

Drive continuous improvement of the machine learning platform and team practices, including MLOps, AI-assisted development, automation, engineering productivity, and modern ways of building and operating ML systems. Support and ensure adherence to governance, lifecycle management, and relevant policies and processes. Monitor model performance, data drift, and impact; ensure appropriate retraining and continuous improvement. Lead and manage the Data Science team, including coaching, feedback, performance discussions, and day-to-day prioritisation.
  
  

Collaborate closely with product, developers, and commercial teams to deliver data-driven solutions end-to-end Communicate insights, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences Requirements Extensive experience in applied data science, analytics, and machine learning. Strong proficiency in Python. Solid understanding of statistical modelling, predictive analytics, experimentation, hypothesis testing, causal reasoning, and model validation. Experience designing, analysing, and interpreting experiments such as AB tests.
  
  

Experience working with SQL and large-scale datasets (e.g. in Databricks / Spark environments). xperience designing, deploying, maintaining, or reviewing models in production or business-critical workflows. Practical understanding of software engineering best practices relevant to machine learning, including testing, version control, code review, documentation, monitoring, and maintainability.
  
  

Experience with MLOps concepts and practices, including model lifecycle management, monitoring, retraining, deployment workflows, and production readiness. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Proven experience leading or mentoring data scientists in a professional setting. Experience working cross-functionally with product, engineering, analytics, commercial, or operational teams to deliver measurable outcomes.
  
  

Experience in iGaming, gaming, e-commerce, fintech, or another high-volume digital product environment.Strong analytical judgement and structured problem-solving ability. Confident technical leader with the ability to challenge, guide, and improve others’ work. Strong understanding of how to build reliable, maintainable, and production- ready machine learning solutions, not just experimental models Clear, concise communicator able to influence both technical and non- technical stakeholders. Comfortable making prioritisation decisions in environments with competing demands and incomplete information The above duties provide a generic description of the Employee’s day to day responsibilities but should in no way be deemed to be an exhaustive list.
  
  

Additional related, duties may be assigned by the Line Manager in line with business exigencies and continuity. Why Work With Us? At Silverspin, we take bold but thoughtful approaches to what we build and how we work. We act with confidence and responsibility, focusing on smart decisions, meaningful impact, and long-term success.
  
  

Joining us means being part of a team that values curiosity, ownership, and collaboration. We encourage people to challenge ideas, simplify complexity, and grow together - creating an environment where great work (and good energy) go hand in hand. We offer: Competitive salary and benefits Opportunities to learn, grow, and develop A creative, collaborative team environment Silverspin is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**Om Devoote**


Devoote är ett konsult- och rekryteringsbolag inom IT. Vi hjälper företag att hitta rätt kompetens inom bland annat systemutveckling, embedded, cloud, data och IT-infrastruktur. Samtidigt hjälper vi kandidater att hitta nya möjligheter och ta nästa steg i karriären.


Vi är ett mindre konsultbolag med cirka 44 konsulter ute på uppdrag, framför allt i Skåne men även i Stockholm. Internt består vi av vår VD och två rekryterare. Tack vare vår storlek har vi korta beslutsvägar, nära kontakt med våra konsulter och stora möjligheter för varje individ att påverka.

**Vad kommer du att få göra?**


Under din praktik får du vara delaktig i flera delar av rekryteringsprocessen och lära dig hur vi arbetar med att hitta och attrahera seniora IT-specialister. Du kommer bland annat att:

* Söka efter och identifiera kandidater via LinkedIn och andra nätverk.
* Ha kontakt med kandidater och hjälpa till med intervjubokningar.
* Delta i intervjuer och möten.
* Vara med och stötta arbetet med employer branding.
* Lära dig hur man bygger långsiktiga relationer med kandidater.
* Få en inblick i konsult- och rekryteringsbranschen.

**Vem är du?**


Du är en social och nyfiken person som tycker om att träffa nya människor och bygga långsiktiga relationer. Du tar gärna egna initiativ, är engagerad i det du gör och vill utvecklas inom HR och rekrytering.


Vi söker dig som:

* Studerar personalvetenskap, HR-programmet eller liknande.
* Ska genomföra en praktik om 15 eller 30 hp.


Praktiken är obetald och behöver därför vara kopplad till dina studier.

**Vad får du hos oss?**


Stöd under hela praktikperioden.  

Praktisk erfarenhet av rekrytering.  

Möjlighet att bygga ett starkt nätverk inom IT-branschen.  

Chansen att utvecklas och få värdefulla erfarenheter inför framtiden.  

Goda möjligheter till anställning efter avslutad praktik.

**Låter det intressant?**


Skicka gärna ditt CV och några korta rader om dig själv så hör vi av oss. Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig och höra mer om vad du vill få ut av din praktik! Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan.

**Varmt välkommen!**

title: Nätverkonsult - Var med och bygg framtidens konsultbolag
description:
Vi söker erfarna nätverkskonsulter som vill arbeta med komplexa miljöer hos några av Sveriges största och mest spännande verksamheter – och samtidigt vara med och bygga nästa generations konsultbolag.


Aranya Consulting är ett växande specialistbolag inom **nätverk, cybersäkerhet och AI**. Nätverk och säker infrastruktur är vår starkaste kompetensbas idag. Våra konsulter arbetar med allt från arkitektur och design till implementation, transformation, migrering, säkerhet och avancerad felsökning.

**Men vi bygger inte ett konsultbolag för gårdagens infrastruktur. Vi bygger för en värld där nätverk, cybersäkerhet, automation och AI växer samman**.

### **Nätverk är grunden – men området förändras**


Vi söker dig som har en stark bakgrund inom nätverk och vill fortsätta utvecklas. Du kanske arbetar med enterprise-nätverk, datacenter, SD-WAN, wireless, routing och switching, nätverkssäkerhet eller automation. Du kan vara en erfaren tekniker, specialist eller arkitekt.


Vi vill veta vad du är riktigt bra på idag och vad du vill kunna i morgon. Relevant erfarenhet och certifieringar är viktiga för oss – men ännu viktigare är din vilja att fortsätta utvecklas i takt med tekniken.


Nätverksområdet förändras snabbt. Cloud och cybersäkerhet har redan förändrat hur vi bygger och skyddar infrastrukturen. Automation förändrar hur den konfigureras och drivs. Och nu kommer AI att förändra området ytterligare. AI och AI-agenter kommer att påverka hur miljöer designas, automatiseras, övervakas och säkras. Samtidigt skapar de nya krav på identitet, åtkomst, segmentering, kontroll och spårbarhet.


Vi vill vara med och bygga den säkra digitala grund som gör att företag och samhälle kan dra nytta av AI – utan att säkerhet och kontroll blir en eftertanke. Därför söker vi nätverksspecialister som vill fortsätta vara riktigt bra på nätverk, men som också är nyfikna på vad som händer när säker infrastruktur möter automation och AI.

### **Fortsätt utvecklas**


Nyfikenhet är viktigt för oss. Tekniken förändras för snabbt för att någon av oss ska kunna luta sig tillbaka på det vi redan kan.


Därför arbetar vi aktivt med individuella utvecklingsplaner och ser **lärande som en viktig del av jobbet**. Hos oss ska du kunna utvecklas från engineer till senior specialist eller arkitekt, fördjupa dig inom nätverk och infrastruktur eller bredda dig mot cybersäkerhet, automation och AI. Vi delar också kunskap med varandra genom lunchföredrag, slack och bloggar.

### **Bygg bolaget tillsammans med oss**


Aranya Consulting växer, men vi vill behålla styrkan i det lilla specialistbolaget: korta beslutsvägar, nära till kollegorna och möjligheten för varje person att faktiskt påverka. Här får du vara med och forma vilka tekniker vi satsar på, vilka tjänster vi bygger och hur vi arbetar tillsammans.


Vi vill också kombinera höga ambitioner med ett hållbart arbetsliv. 40 timmar är 40 timmar. Vi vill att våra konsulter ska ha spännande uppdrag, fortsätta utvecklas och samtidigt ha ett liv utanför jobbet.


Vi har en stark position inom nätverk och säker infrastruktur idag. Nu bygger vi vidare för en framtid där nätverk, cybersäkerhet och AI blir allt mer integrerade.

**Vill du vara med och bygga den framtiden tillsammans med oss? Då vill vi gärna träffa dig.**

**Aranya Consulting är en del av Aranya AB** – ett svenskt bolag där ägarna själva är aktiva i verksamheten. Aranya är specialiserat på nätverk och cybersäkerhet och erbjuder bland annat nätverk som tjänst genom den egenutvecklade plattformen ACP.

title: System Architect
description:

* Proven track record of designing, leading, and embedding strategic people initiatives, talent management frameworks, and organizational change programs that drive business performance and transformation.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to influence, challenge, and coach senior leaders on organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, leadership development, and people-related decisions.
* Comfortable working in an international environment and adapting global and regional frameworks to local business and regulatory requirements across European markets.

* We may work with tomorrow’s technology, but at our core we are a people-oriented organization

description:

---------------


Join AWS's Edge Services team as the CDN and Edge Sales Specialist for the Nordics owning the full sales cycle for Amazon CloudFront and AWS Edge Services across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, and Iceland from our Stockholm office. If you have a passion for content delivery, a competitive streak for winning CDN workloads, and a track record of building business in the Nordics, this is your opportunity to shape a high-growth market at the world's leading cloud provider.  

  

Lead the Nordics Edge business end-to-end: grow existing accounts through cross-sell/up-sell, prospect into new logos, and compete head-to-head against Akamai, Cloudflare, Fastly, and others  

Design compelling commercial constructs private pricing, commit-based deals, and migration incentives to win and retain CDN workloads  

Partner with account teams, solutions architects, and AWS partners to deliver a best-in-class customer experience across the region  

Bring your CDN industry expertise (vendor-side or partner-side) and deep Nordics market knowledge to a team that values ownership, customer obsession, and bold thinking  

Be part of a diverse, inclusive team that invests in your growth, offers flexible working, and puts work-life balance at the center of everything we do  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own the full Edge Services sales cycle across the Nordics (Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Iceland) from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, close, and post-launch expansion
* Develop and deepen relationships with existing AWS customers to identify cross-sell and up-sell opportunities across the Edge portfolio (CloudFront, AWS WAF, Shield)
* Prospect into new accounts where AWS does not have a CDN presence today, building net-new pipeline and converting greenfield opportunities into Edge wins
* Shape and execute competitive commercial constructs including private pricing, commit-based deals, and migration incentives to displace incumbent CDN providers
* Build and execute a territory plan for the Nordics Edge business, aligning with regional account managers, solutions architects, and AWS leadership on priorities and targets
* Engage customers at both C-level and technical levels through presentations, business-value assessments, and technical workshops that articulate the AWS Edge value proposition
* Collaborate with AWS partners, ISVs, and system integrators to extend market reach and accelerate CDN adoption across the region
* Maintain an accurate and healthy pipeline, deliver reliable forecasts, and participate in all AWS operating cadences (WBRs, QBRs, pipeline reviews)
* Serve as the voice of the Nordics Edge customer back into AWS product and engineering teams, influencing roadmap priorities based on regional market needs
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in CDN, Edge, or content delivery technology sales
* Experience selling at a CDN vendor or at a designated partner/reseller of such vendors
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas in a direct sales role
* Experience selling into the Nordics or similar European markets
* Strong understanding of CDN architectures, DNS, DDoS protection, and web application firewalls
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

* Experience with AWS Edge Services, particularly Amazon CloudFront, AWS WAF, Shield, Route 53, and Global Accelerator

* Experience structuring complex commercial agreements including commit-based pricing, private pricing, or enterprise discount programs
* Technical background in networking, content delivery architectures, or cloud infrastructure
* Proficiency in Swedish or another Nordic language (Norwegian, Danish, Finnish)

title: Designer till Brandworks Göteborg
description:
Brandworks kreativa team expanderar till Göteborg och vi söker nu en erfaren designer till vårt Göteborgskontor.

**Vilka är Brandworks?**


Vi är en Brand Experience-byrå inom koncept, strategi, event och varumärkesbyggande inredning. Vår styrka ligger i att förena idé, innovation, design och hantverk för att skapa unika och värdeskapande produktioner för våra kunder – alltid med hållbarhet i fokus, både för planeten och människor.

**Vad kan vi erbjuda?**


Hos Brandworks får du arbeta med design som blir verklighet. Du får vara med och skapa fysiska miljöer, installationer och upplevelser från första idé till färdig produktion – och se dina skisser faktiskt byggas.


Du blir en del av ett kreativt och engagerat team där designers, projektledare, konstruktörer, produktionsspecialister och montörer arbetar nära varandra. Vi har korta beslutsvägar, stor kompetens inom huset och en kultur där vi gärna delar idéer och hjälps åt för att hitta den bästa lösningen.


Vi sitter i nya fina lokaler mitt i Göteborg och lägger stor vikt vid att ha en arbetsplats där människor trivs, utvecklas och har roligt tillsammans. Vi hittar gärna på saker även utanför jobbet – allt från träning och AW till andra gemensamma aktiviteter.

**Rollen i korthet**


Som designer hos Brandworks kommer du att arbeta med att utveckla kreativa uttag och designlösningar för fysiska miljöer och varumärkesupplevelser.


Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med:

* Retail- och butiksmiljöer
* Pop-ups och brand spaces
* Mässmontrar och expo
* Event- och upplevelsemiljöer
* Installationer och varumärkesaktiveringar


Du kommer in tidigt i projekten och arbetar med att omvandla idéer och briefar till visuella och fysiska lösningar. Det kan handla om att ta fram koncept och moodboards, skissa idéer, designa produktdisplayer, rendera cadmodeller, utveckla miljöer och detaljer samt skapa presentationer och ritningsunderlag.


Du arbetar nära projektledare och kunder, men också tillsammans med våra konstruktörer och produktionsspecialister för att säkerställa att designen speglar produktionens förutsättningar.


Det är därför viktigt att du både har ett starkt estetiskt öga och en förståelse för material, konstruktion, funktion och produktion.

**Vem är du?**


Vi tror att du är en designer med några års erfarenhet av fysisk design, visulisering och 3dmodellering, inredning, retail, event eller liknande och som trivs bäst när dina idéer får ta fysisk form.


Du är:

* Kreativ, nyfiken och lösningsorienterad
* Van att utveckla idéer från koncept till färdig design
* Duktig på att visualisera och presentera dina idéer
* Bekväm med att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra
* Intresserad av material, detaljer, konstruktion och hur saker faktiskt produceras
* Van att hantera flera projekt parallellt och hålla deadlines
* Trygg i dialogen med både kunder och kollegor
* Prestigelös och tycker om att hitta lösningar tillsammans


Du behöver inte ha arbetat med exakt alla typer av projekt ovan. Det viktigaste är att du har erfarenhet av att designa fysiska miljöer, produkter och upplevelser och en vilja att utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

**Dina verktyg**


Vi ser att du är van att arbeta i:

* Adobe Creative Cloud
* Rhino, AutoCAD eller liknande
* Andra verktyg inom ai-generering, rendering , visualisering och presentation

**Varför Brandworks?**


Hos oss får du kombinera kreativitet med möjligheten att faktiskt bygga det du skapar. Du får följa dina idéer hela vägen från skissbordet till färdig miljö och arbeta tillsammans med människor som kan design, konstruktion och produktion på riktigt.


Vi är ett växande bolag med stora ambitioner, men med en entreprenöriell och personlig kultur där det finns gott om utrymme att påverka. Här får du möjlighet att utvecklas, ta ansvar och vara med och forma både dina projekt och Brandworks fortsatta utveckling.

**Placering och arbetssätt**


Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats är vårt kontor i Göteborg. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med projektteamet och våra övriga funktioner, och vi ser därför kontoret som den naturliga utgångspunkten. Visst resande kan förekomma i samband med kundmöten, produktioner och projekt.


Vi erbjuder en tillsvidareanställning med fast månadslön. Startdatum enligt överenskommelse.


Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vår jobbportal, ej via mail. Intervjuer sker löpande.

**Varmt välkommen med din ansökan och portfolio – vi ser fram emot att se vad du kan skapa tillsammans med oss!**

title: Engineering Manager / Tech Lead - Ethena Pay
description:
### **Role Overview**


We're building a new engineering team at Ethena to own the Ethena Pay product. A neobanking experience app built on top of our stablecoin infrastructure. You'll take the technical and people leadership of that team, shaping the architecture, setting the engineering bar, hiring the people around you, and shipping the hardest parts yourself.


This is a hands-on player-coach role, not a hands-off manager seat. While the team is small, you'll spend most of your week writing and shipping production code — you'll be one of the strongest individual contributors on the team, take the most critical work yourself, and review everyone else's. Leadership, architecture, and hiring sit on top of that, not in place of it. As the team grows the balance shifts toward leadership, but coding stays a standing part of the job.


It's a rare combination: the scope and autonomy of an early-stage build — you own the architecture, shape the team, and decide how it works — with the backing, treasury, and distribution of one of the largest companies in stablecoins behind you.

### **Role Responsibilities**

* Write and ship production code most days as one of the team’s top ICs, taking on the hardest and most critical-path work and unblocking the team members you’re responsible for.
* Own the architecture. Hold the whole system in your head — services, money-paths, data model, infrastructure, on-chain settlement — and make the design calls that keep it correct, legible, and extensible as it scales.
* Build the team. Run a rigorous, humane hiring loop; raise the bar; onboard new engineers with real plans; grow a small senior team that works in the open.
* Set and hold a high engineering bar. Non-author review on money paths, CI required to merge, small PRs, disciplined testing (TDD / BDD as the default, not an afterthought), always-on automated review, idempotency and correctness treated as non-negotiable. Establish safe, effective agentic-development practices as the team's default.
* Own the delivery cadence. Run a tight, high-velocity delivery process — sprints or kanban, whatever fits the team — with predictable, versioned releases, a healthy backlog, and short lead time from idea to production. Ship fast without lowering the bar.
* Make it reliable. Drive real production alerting, an on-call rotation that pages a human, tested runbooks, and incident response — so the team can build, ship, and run the product with confidence.

### **Required Skills and Experience**

* You've led engineering for a consumer money product — a neobank, payments, or crypto money app - where a bug moves or loses real customer money. You owned an engineering function where correctness had genuine financial stakes.
* You've led a small team (~3–8) while still shipping code yourself — tech lead, staff, or hands-on engineering manager. You've shipped production code within the last year; this is not a management-ladder-only background.
* You've owned production operations for a money system — on-call, real incidents, observability, secret and key hygiene — not just delegated it. You can name incidents you personally drove to resolution.
* You've owned, or overseen the integration of, regulated third-party financial rails — at least two of: card issuing / BIN-sponsor programs (Marqeta, Lithic, Kulipa, Stripe Issuing), identity / KYC / onboarding (SumSub, Persona, Onfido), banking or fiat on-/off-ramp partners (a BaaS or ramp partner), and key custody / signing (cloud KMS, HSM, MPC, or multisig).
* You run a high-velocity, disciplined delivery process. You've led a team that ships fast and predictably in an agile setup — sprints or kanban, versioned releases, short lead time to production — without trading away quality. Test-driven and behaviour-driven development are how you build, not box-ticking.
* You're agent-native. You wield agentic development — coding agents (e.g. Claude Code), MCP servers, reusable skills — as a core multiplier, with a real point of view on adopting it safely on a money product. Fluent, not a dabbler; you know the failure modes and verify output.

### **Technical breadth to lead this team**

* You'll lead engineers across backend, platform, and mobile, and set the standard each is built to. You must be deep in backend / distributed systems and genuinely literate across the rest — enough to review the work and make the architecture call in each:
* Backend & payments correctness (your core). Strong TypeScript / Node (or a credible senior path from Go / Kotlin / Java); you think natively in idempotency, reconciliation, retries, and consistency under partial failure, across event-driven services and Postgres.
* Client-facing APIs & auth. The app-facing API as a product — versioning, idempotency keys, a clean error model — plus the auth backend behind it (OAuth2 / OIDC, session lifecycle, WebAuthn / passkeys).
* Platform & reliability. Enough Kubernetes, IaC, and observability (OTel / Grafana-class) to own the deploy/rollback story and hold the reliability bar — you know the difference between a dashboard that exists and an alert that pages.
* Native mobile. Enough to review a native iOS app (Swift / SwiftUI) and reason about mobile backend contracts, failure states, and on-device auth.

 Find us on Instagram: @optimizely
   

  

**Introduction**
 Optimizely is expanding its global operational capability and is now looking for a Situation Manager / Incident Commander to strengthen our Incident response function. In this role, you will lead real-time command of high-severity incidents across Optimizely’s DXP platform—including CMS, Commerce, PaaS, and cloud hosting in Azure and GCP.
   

  

 This is a high-impact operational leadership role where you coordinate cross-functional teams, maintain situational awareness, and drive rapid restoration of service for customers across the globe.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Act as the Incident Commander for high-severity incidents, ensuring fast, structured, and coordinated response.
* Maintain full situational awareness and manage the incident timeline, scope, communications, and decision-making.
* Lead Engineering, SRE, Support, and Customer Success teams through the incident lifecycle.
* Own clear communication to internal stakeholders, including executives, product teams, and customer-facing groups.
* Provide customer-facing status updates during Major Incidents and ensure external communication standards are met.
* Run structured incident bridges, drive focus, and ensure that actions, responsibilities, and follow-ups are clear.
* Ensure accurate incident documentation and support the delivery of Incident Reports, RFO/RCA, and executive summaries.
* Drive continuous improvement of Incident processes, including detection, escalation rules, and communication workflows.
* Contribute to the development of playbooks, runbooks, and automation to reduce MTTR and improve reliability.
* Be part of the global on-call rotation to support 24/7 coverage with a strong focus on EMEA hours.


**Knowledge And Experience**
* Demonstrated experience as an Incident Commander, Situation Manager, or Incident Lead in SaaS, PaaS, or hosting operations.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams under pressure and make structured, high-quality decisions quickly.
* Deep understanding of operational frameworks such as ITIL Incident Management.
* Strong communication skills, clear, assertive, and calm, capable of handling both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience coordinating incidents involving distributed, cloud-based systems (Azure and/or GCP is a plus).
* Strong situational awareness, ability to prioritize signal over noise, and maintain control of high-pressure calls.
* Experience with customer communication during critical events.
* Fluent in English and Swedish.
* Background in Engineering, SRE, or Technical Operations.
* Experience with multi-cloud environments or large-scale global SaaS platforms.
* Experience with Application Insights, Datadog, or similar observability tools.


**Education**
 Bachelor’s Degree (Computer Science or engineering preferred) or equivalent work experience
   

  

**Competencies**
 Optimizely is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Optimizely is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Telness Tech is on a mission to simplify and digitize the telecom industry. Our platform powers next-generation mobile providers, from traditional MVNOs to eSIM challengers and non-telecom players looking to embed connectivity into their offerings. With our roots in Stockholm and our sights on a global scale, we’re building the future of telecom—fast, flexible, and customer-first.
   

  

 As we accelerate our growth, we’re seeking Senior Software Engineers to help us become the global leader in #teltech.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will work with a team of skilled engineers and build modern architecture and technology. Our backend is built in Golang and runs in AWS using Kubernetes. Communication between backend services utilizes gRPC, and the frontend uses React. We use both GraphQL and REST, and primarily use PostgreSQL databases with event sourcing.
   

  

 We are scaling up our platform to new markets with dynamic requirements, and you will play a crucial role in shaping, designing, and building fundamental components. As the company expands, you will help us tackle new and interesting challenges, scaling our platform from tens of thousands to hundreds of millions of users.
   

  

 We have openings in multiple teams, and hiring will be based on your background, skills, and technical interests. For the right person, there are opportunities to take on a leading technical role, whether from day one or over time, helping the team build a clear technical vision and make strategic technology choices as we scale.
   

  

**About You**
 You are an experienced Sr. Software Engineer who has probably worked at several companies, including at least one startup, and has grown with them from an early stage. You are currently working with Go (or a similar) in a full-stack, backend-focused role and are comfortable diving into occasional front-end work with React. You are excited about joining a startup journey where you will shape both product and technology while working in a small, high-autonomy team.
   

  

**What You Bring To The Table**
* 5+ years as a backend/full-stack engineer in a modern tech environment.
* Strong experience with Go (Golang) and SQL (bonus for GraphQL, React, Typescript).
* Ability to collaborate effectively and solve complex technical problems as part of a team.
* Passion for technology and excitement for the challenges of continuously adapting technology and working methods to support our scaling journey.
* Take ownership of your growth and support the development of others, eager to learn and share knowledge.
* Drives technical and process improvements, actively seeking ways to enhance technology and workflows, with a motivation to implement positive changes for both the team and the company.
* Autonomous, self-motivated, likes new challenges, and takes responsibility.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with high proficiency in English.


**Why Telness Tech?**
 We’re not building for telco as it is—we’re building for how it should be: fast-moving, easy to use, and built for the people who use it. At Telness Tech, you’ll join a curious, ambitious, and transparent team. We work hard, we move fast, and we support each other every step of the way.
   

  

 Here’s what you can expect:
   

  

* Be part of an exciting startup journey with strong funding and international expansion.
* Play an active role in building one of the telecom industry’s most innovative companies.
* A high-trust, high-autonomy environment where you’ll be encouraged to take ownership and explore growth opportunities for both Telness Tech and your development.
* A friendly, positive, and supportive workplace that fosters collaboration and constructive challenge.
* Free daily breakfast, regular "Friday" AWs, and fun activities!
* Hybrid/remote work setup with an office in central Stockholm.


 Sounds like your challenge?
   

  

 Let’s talk.
   

  

*Currently, we are unable to support work permits or relocation.*

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
Location: Stockholm, Sweden
   

  

 Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.
   

  

 "As market leader within Digital Identity and Security, Thales makes personal digital interaction simple and secure in an increasingly connected society. From secure software to biometrics and encryption, Thales provides technologies and services that enables business and governments to authenticate identities and protect data, enabling its clients to offer trusted digital services to billions of individuals. Located in Älvsjö since 2012, the site houses both a commercial office as well as two productions within Identity & Biometric Solutions, and Banking & Payment Services. Working commercially across all business areas within Digital Identity and Security, Thales has become a trusted partner within various businesses as well as governments throughout the Nordics.
   

  

**Role: Service Delivery Manager**
**Base location: Stockholm, Sweden (Hybrid)**
**Security process:** 
 This position requires that you undergo and be approved in accordance with the applicable regulations for security protection. For positions where Thales has requirements for security clearance, this may entail a requirement for local citizenship.
   

  

**Identity & Biometric Solutions (IBS) business line**
 Thales Identity and Biometric Solutions (IBS) Business Line is part of the global Thales Group, which employs more than 80,000 people in 68 countries.
   

  

 Thales delivers identity and biometric solutions to governments, public authorities, and private entities in civil identity and public security. We do this by providing highly secure documents, such as passports, ID cards, driver’s licenses, etc., at the heart of identity schemes. We also provide solutions for verifying people’s identities, for example, when they cross borders and enrolling them in national registers. Both of these are built on our expertise in biometrics.
   

  

 And, as governments go through a digital transformation, we support them by delivering secure, convenient, and feature-proof mobile identity, digital identity wallet, platform, and services. We also address public security and law enforcement challenges by offering the latest in criminal forensics and real-time facial recognition.
   

  

**Description**
 Thales Cybersecurity & Digital & Identity (CDI) provides Customers with technology to assist them in Identity and Biometric Solutions (IBS) business line.
   

  

 Service Delivery Manager (SDM) shall manage the support and maintenance contracts related to Government Solutions (including Software and equipment supplied by Thales as well as third parties). SDM will ensure customer satisfaction in respect of contractual commitments, and the fulfilment of Service level agreements (SLA). SDM will be mainly involved in governance of incident, problem, and change management on the complete solution with contribution to upsell and new opportunities.
   

  

 The installed Biometric and Public Security Solutions with associated software, hardware and peripherals are integrated with the Customers processes. SDM work with the Customer, Thales Internal and External Partner Suppliers and Thales Development/Senior Technical Teams (Level 2 and Level 3 Support) to ensure our response and restoration processes are aligned to contractual SLA and Availability and Reliability are maximised.
   

  

 The role will work closely with different departments at our Älvsjö Office. The Line Manager is located abroad and so is several of the other Service Delivery Managers in the Manager’s team.
   

  

**Key responsibilities include:**
* Act as the primary customer interface for Support and Maintenance (S&M) contracts.
* Manage customer accounts by providing regular activity reporting, including weekly and monthly updates, steering committee materials, KPI reports, and SLA reports; recommend service improvements; and support contract renewals and new commercial proposals in coordination with Sales.
* Monitor incident resolution, ensure SLA compliance, and manage escalations whenever required.
* Monitor contract financial performance and maintain a strong focus on customer satisfaction.
* Manage third-party contracts, communications, and performance monitoring where applicable.
* Coordinate and follow up on actions involving third parties and internal support teams, ensuring alignment with Thales processes.
* Prepare, plan, and manage the execution of changes in coordination with technical teams.
* Coordinate contractual activities such as preventive maintenance operations.
* Provide internal reporting on account activities and profitability; manage the contract using Thales tools in accordance with Thales processes.


**Knowledge, Skills and Experience:**
* An engineering degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* At least five years of experience in service delivery management or project management for IT solutions.
* Strong customer relationship management skills.
* ITIL Foundation certification.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Swedish.
* Ability to travel at short notice within Europe.
* Eligibility for security clearance for Swedish customer.
* Experience working with remote teams.
* Experience in government-related activities is a plus.


**What we offer:**
* Competitive compensation package including base salary and performance-based incentives.
* A key role in shaping the company’s presence in a strategically important region.
* Opportunity to work with innovative technologies and cross-border teams.
* Professional development, training, and career advancement opportunities.


 At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

title: Security Engineer, Corporate
description:
**TL;DR** 
 You'll secure how Lovable works - the laptops, identities, SaaS apps, and AI tools 250+ Lovables use every day - without slowing anyone down.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 5+ years in corporate, enterprise, or endpoint security at a fast-growing tech company.
* Deep expertise in identity (Google Workspace/Okta/Entra, SSO, SCIM, conditional access), MDM (Jamf/Kandji/Intune), and SaaS security posture (SSPM).
* You can write code (Python, Bash, or Go) and treat policies as software - versioned, tested, deployed.
* Strong instincts for IT risks such as phishing, social engineering, and insider risk - including the new AI-flavored variants.
* Pragmatic about UX. You know when a control is real security and when it's just friction.
* Bonus: experience securing AI tools and agents in the workplace (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, et al).
* Bonus: experience managing hardware security keys


**What You'll Do**
* Own the security of Lovable's corporate environment: identity, endpoints, SaaS, email, and the AI tools we live in.
* Roll out and maintain controls that scale - passkeys, device trust, conditional access, DLP, SSPM.
* Run phishing, awareness, and tabletop programs that actually change behavior.
* Work on Detection & Response to make detection of insider and account-takeover risk first-class.
* Secure and optimise our diverse AI toolstack, including Lovable itself, working closely with the product team on feedback and iterations
* Help the Security and GRC teams make least-privilege the default and auditability free.
* Ensure the right data is surfaced to the right people, while implementing data classifications and reducing the risk of data loss


**Our Stack**
* Devices: macOS, Linux, Kandji, Crowdstrike
* Networking: Tailscale, Cloudflare, Meter, Unifi
* IAM: Google Workspace, Okta, Entra
* Dev tools/data: Lovable, GitHub, BigQuery, various AI tools
* GRC: Vanta, Wiz


**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Security Manager, Credit & Wealth – Tieto Banktech (m/f/d)
description:

 Tieto Banktech is a leading financial services software, and solutions partner in the Nordics, delivering modular, pre-integrated Banking-as-a-Service platforms and mission-critical software for core banking, payments, credit, cards, fraud prevention, and wealth management. Our solutions operate in highly regulated, high-availability environments where security, resilience, and compliance are non-negotiable.
   

  

 Security is fundamental to the trust our customers place in our products and services. We are looking for an experienced Security Manager to take ownership of security governance across our Credit & Wealth business unit, protecting our SaaS platforms, development environments, and operational services.
   

  

 This is a security governance and leadership role that requires a strong understanding of the technical craft of security management. You will oversee security operations, incident response, risk management, and regulatory compliance, while being able to engage with and challenge technical teams on how security is implemented in practice. Working closely with Banktech Security, engineering, cloud and infrastructure teams, and other key control functions, you will strengthen our security posture and embed security into how we build and operate our services.
   

  

**As Security Manager, you will:**
**Security Operations & Incident Response**
* Act as Lead Security Incident Manager for Product Development and SaaS / Managed Services
* Own and drive security incident response processes, including detection, containment, eradication, recovery, and post‑incident analysis
* Coordinate technical resolution with product owners, architects, engineering teams, site reliability / operations, and service managers
* Ensure proper root cause analysis (RCA), corrective actions, and preventive controls are identified and implemented
* Maintain accurate and complete incident documentation in line with audit and regulatory expectations


**Security Governance & Risk Management**
**Own and evolve the security framework for the business unit, covering:**
* Information security
* Cloud and application security
* Product development security (SDLC / DevSecOps)
* Physical and operational security
* Business continuity and resilience
* Perform risk assessments and threat analysis across systems, services, and processes
* Translate risk findings into concrete technical and procedural controls
* Support and contribute to BCP/DR planning, technical resilience testing, and operational continuity activities


**Security Enablement**
* Provide technical security guidance to product development, platform, and operations teams
* Embed security requirements into architecture decisions, technical designs, and delivery processes
* Drive security awareness and training, with a focus on secure development and operational practices
* Act as the primary security escalation and advisory contact for the business unit


**Who You Are**
**Experience & Background**
* +8 years of experience in security roles within software development and SaaS / managed service environments
* Strong experience in:
+ Security incident handling and forensics collaboration
+ Risk assessment and control design
+ Security governance in large, complex organizations

* Experience from financial services, banking, or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience working with customer, audit, and regulatory security requirements.


**Technical & Professional Skills**
* Strong understanding of software development, platforms, infrastructure, and cloud security concepts.
* Good understanding of secure SDLC and DevSecOps practices and the ability to assess how security is implemented throughout the development lifecycle.
* Experience working with relevant standards and assurance frameworks, such as:
+ ISO 27001
+ SOC 1 / SOC 2
+ Integrated management systems, including ISO 9001 and ISO 14001

* Experience implementing, governing, or maintaining security compliance programs and certifications.
* Strong documentation skills with the ability to produce clear, audit-ready material.
* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.


**Personal Profile**
* Customer-focused with strong business acumen.
* Clear and structured communicator with strong spoken and written English.
* Credible and confident advisor to engineers, product managers, customers, and senior stakeholders.
* Able to challenge constructively and drive security requirements to resolution.
* Pragmatic and able to balance security, regulatory requirements, availability, resilience, and business needs.


**We offer**
 We offer you professional growth, meaningful projects, open culture and an outstanding work-life balance! We offer you an opportunity to create the future of a growing, fast-developing and important sector. We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge.
   

  

**Did we get you inspired?**
 We look forward to your application!
   

  

 Interviews will be held continuously, so we encourage you to apply today! For more information or questions, please contact Talent Acquisition team recruitmentinbanking@tieto.com
   

  

 Hope to hear from you soon!

 At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: Information Security Officer – Cybersäkerhet
description:
**Om rollen**
 Som Information Security Officer arbetar du både strategiskt, taktiskt och operativt med informations- och cybersäkerhet inom Svea Bank och våra europeiska dotterbolag. Rollen tillhör informationssäkerhetsfunktionen och rapporterar till CISO, med nära samarbete med IT, utveckling, SOC, risk, compliance och verksamheten.
   

  

 Du identifierar och analyserar säkerhetsrisker, genomför granskningar och omsätter regulatoriska krav och tekniska risker till konkreta åtgärder. Rollen passar dig som trivs i gränslandet mellan teknik, risk och verksamhet.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**
* Genomföra säkerhetsgranskningar och riskbedömningar av system, applikationer, molntjänster och leverantörer.
* Stödja projekt, upphandlingar och förändringsinitiativ med säkerhetskrav och riskanalyser.
* Omsätta krav från exempelvis DORA och ISO 27001 till praktiska säkerhetskontroller.
* Följa upp sårbarheter, penetrationstester och åtgärdsplaner.
* Bidra till incidenthantering och utveckling av bankens cyberresiliens.
* Utveckla styrning, kontroller, rapportering och arbetssätt inom informationssäkerhetsområdet.


**Vi söker dig som har:**
* Minst fem års erfarenhet inom informationssäkerhet, cybersäkerhet eller IT-risk.
* Erfarenhet av säkerhetsgranskningar och riskbedömningar.
* God teknisk förståelse inom exempelvis identitet och behörighet, nätverk, molntjänster, applikationer och sårbarhetshantering.
* Kunskap om ISO 27001 och förståelse för regulatoriska krav såsom DORA.
* Förmåga att kommunicera tekniska risker till både tekniska och icke-tekniska målgrupper.
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.


**Meriterande**
 Meriterande om du har erfarenhet från bank, finans eller annan reglerad verksamhet. Har du kunskap inom Azure, AWS eller Microsoft 365 och erfarenhet av IAM/PAM, SOC, SIEM eller EDR är det också ett stort plus. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av säker systemutveckling, DevSecOps eller applikationssäkerhet.
   

  

**För att lyckas i rollen är du:**
 Du är analytisk, lösningsorienterad och trivs med att arbeta självständigt. Du har förmåga att kombinera teknisk förståelse med ett verksamhetsperspektiv och kan omsätta risker till konkreta förbättringar. Samtidigt är du kommunikativ, pragmatisk och skapar framdrift genom samarbete och påverkan.
   

  

**Om Svea**
 Svea är ett finansiellt företag med över 40 års erfarenhet av att skapa smarta och hållbara lösningar för företag och privatpersoner. Med verksamhet i flera europeiska länder erbjuder vi tjänster inom bland annat betalningar, finansiering, inkasso och bankverksamhet. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i en entreprenöriell organisation där engagemang, samarbete och utveckling står i fokus.

title: IT-Support Specialist to atNorth, Stockholm
description:
atNorth is a leading Nordic data center services company that offers cost-effective, scalable colocation and high-performance computing services trusted by industry-leading organizations. The business acquired leading High Performance Computing (HPC) provider, Gompute, in 2023 enabling a compelling full stack offering tailored to AI and other critical high performance workloads. With sustainability at its core, atNorth's data centers run on renewable energy resources and support circular economy principles. All atNorth sites leverage innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations to provide long-term infrastructure and flexible colocation deployments. The tailor-made solutions enable businesses to calculate, simulate, train and visualize data workloads in an efficient, cost-optimized way. atNorth is headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland and operates eight data centers in strategic locations across the Nordics, with a site to open in Ballerup, Denmark in 2025, as well as its tenth under construction in Kouvola, Finland and its eleventh site in Ølgod, Denmark. The business has also secured land for a future mega site in the Sollefteå Municipality in Sweden. For more information, visit atNorth.com or follow atNorth on LinkedIn or Facebook.
 



  





 Do you enjoy providing hands-on IT support and creating a great employee experience? Are you motivated by solving technical challenges, supporting users in their daily work, and being part of a fast-growing Nordic technology company? If so, the IT Support Specialist role at atNorth could be the opportunity for you.
 



  





 This position is offered as a 12-month fixed-term contract with a strong likelihood of extension or permanent employment.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As IT Support Specialist, you will play a key role in supporting atNorth's continued growth across the Nordic region. You will be responsible for delivering responsive and high-quality onsite IT support to approximately 100 employees in Finland while working closely with colleagues across the Nordic IT organization.
 



  





 This is a highly visible and hands-on role where you will support employees with their day-to-day IT needs, contribute to onboarding and offboarding activities, manage local IT equipment, and help ensure a seamless workplace technology experience. You will work closely with central IT teams in Iceland as well as external service providers while contributing to the development of a scalable and service-oriented IT support function.
 



  





**Your responsibilities will include:** 



* Providing onsite first- and second-line IT support to employees.
* Troubleshooting and resolving hardware, software and workplace technology issues.
* Supporting onboarding and offboarding activities, including account administration and device preparation.
* Installing, configuring and maintaining laptops, mobile devices and workplace equipment.
* Managing IT assets and maintaining accurate documentation.
* Coordinating with external IT vendors and service providers when required.
* Collaborating closely with teams within IT Support, Infrastructure, Cyber Security and IT Operations.
* Identifying opportunities for process improvements and contributing to the development of local support routines.
* The role might require occasional travel between atNorth datacenter locations within the country to provide on-site IT Support.
* Ensuring compliance with internal IT policies and security standards.



  





 The role reports to the Head of Infrastructure, Cyber Security and IT Support and is part of a growing Nordic IT organization focused on delivering a high-quality employee experience across the region. The position is based at atNorth's SWE01 site in Kista, Stockholm.
 



  





**Is this You?** 




 To succeed in this role, you enjoy helping others and take pride in delivering excellent service. You are proactive, structured and comfortable working independently while collaborating across teams and countries.
 



  





 You likely have:
 


* At least 2 years of experience within IT Support, Service Desk, Workplace Technology, End User Support or a similar role.
* Experience providing hands-on onsite IT support in a corporate environment.
* Experience supporting Microsoft 365 users and environments.
* Experience installing, configuring and troubleshooting laptops, mobile devices and workplace technology.
* Experience working with ticketing or IT service management systems.
* Knowledge of Windows environments and common workplace IT infrastructure.
* Fluency in Finnish and English, both written and spoken.y



  





 Experience working in an international organization, supporting multiple locations, or using tools such as Intune, Entra ID and Mobile Device Management solutions is considered an advantage.
 



 As a person, you are service-minded, approachable and solution-oriented. You take ownership, communicate effectively with a variety of stakeholders and enjoy working in a growing and evolving environment.
 



  





**Why atNorth?** 




 At atNorth, you will join a fast-growing Nordic technology company at an exciting stage of development. You will have the opportunity to help shape a newly established local IT support function, work closely with experienced colleagues across the Nordics and gain broad exposure to IT Infrastructure, Cyber Security and IT Operations. You will also become part of an open, collaborative and people-focused culture where employees are encouraged to take ownership, share knowledge and contribute to continuous improvement.
 



  





**Want to know more?** 




 In this recruitment, atNorth collaborates with Level Recruitment. You apply for the position by clicking on the "apply" button. For questions, contact recruitment consultant Carolina Eskengren on +46 8 120 50 427. Apply with a CV that clearly outlines your relevant experience.

title: Trade & Logistics konsult (hybrid)
description:
Att arbeta på COSMO CONSULT är inte som på andra ställen.
   

  

 Utforska vår COSMO-verse och låt dig inspireras av den positiva energin bland COSMOnautarna. Tillsammans skapar vi framtiden - for people, by people. Vi utvecklas tillsammans.

 Anslut dig till vårt team och bli en del av en av världens ledande Microsoft-partners för verksamhetstransformation och digitalisering.
   

  

**Älska ditt jobb** 
 på nytt – skicka oss din ansökan som
   

  

 Trade & Logistics konsult
   

  

 Om tjänsten:
   

  

* Som konsult inom vårt område Trade & Logistics blir din viktigaste uppgift att hjälpa våra kunder inom handel och logistik att förbättra och utveckla sina affärsprocesser. Du kommer vara delaktig i projekt som rör både införande av nya affärssystem och löpande förbättringsarbete. Du skapar värde för kunden genom din förståelse för kundens verksamhet och förmåga att vägleda dem till processförbättringar som möjliggörs med affärssystemet Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
* Våra arbetsformer innebär att du ibland arbetar i ett större projektteam och ibland möter kunden själv. Viss del av arbetet görs på något av våra kontor och viss del av arbetet görs ute hos våra kunder. Detta innebär att tjänsten kan innebära en del resor beroende på kund och projekt. Möjligheten finns även att få delta i internationella projekt.
* Arbetet som konsult är otroligt spännande och varierande - och du kommer snabbt att se att det arbete du utför skapar resultat hos kunderna. Hos oss på COSMO CONSULT kommer du få möjligheter att arbeta tillsammans med flera av Sveriges mest erfarna och kompetenta BC/NAV-kollegor. För oss är teamwork en självklarhet, och vi hjälper varandra att kontinuerligt förbättras.


 Du har erfarenhet av:
   

  

* Relevant utbildning från högskola eller universitet och flera års kvalificerad erfarenhet från tillverkande industri, antingen som ledare i linjebefattning eller som affärssystemkonsult.
* Flera års erfarenhet från implementationer av Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central/Dynamics NAV eller annat relevant affärssystem, som konsult alternativt som superanvändare på kundsidan. Ett plus är om du har erfarenhet av att jobba i projekt med Azure DevOps. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.
* Vi söker dig som är en förtroendeingivande representant för COSMO CONSULT. Du har ett starkt kundfokus och slutför alltid de uppdrag som du påbörjat. Det är även viktigt att du är ansvarstagande och kan driva din egen utveckling mot uppsatta mål, även om vi alltid finns där som stöd. För att passa in i vårt team tror vi att du trivs med att arbeta som en del i en projektgrupp likväl som att utföra uppdrag på egen hand. Som lagspelare har du en stark vilja att dela med dig av din kunskap till andra samt visar andra respekt och omtanke. Utifrån senioritetsnivå bidrar du även till egen beläggning samt deltar i varierande omfattning i marknadsbearbetning hos befintliga och nya kunder


 Lika lika och unika.
   

  

 Det är det som skiljer oss åt:
   

  

* Hos oss är alla en del av teamet - din röst behövs, även när det gäller vår egen företagsutveckling.
* Det är viktigt för oss att du känner dig uppskattad och sedd.
* Platsoberoende och flexibelt arbete är en självklarhet för oss. I rollen ingår det att kontinuerligt besöka något av våra kontor runt om i Sverige: Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö och Umeå.
* Internationellt samarbete är en del av vår vardag - upptäck andra kulturer och nya miljöer.
* En säker och positiv arbetsmiljö är vår högsta prioritet.
* Förändring är en del av oss, och det är därför vi aldrig står stilla utan alltid utvecklas.
* Det ligger oss varmt om hjärtat att tillsammans med dig forma din vidareutveckling.
* Hos oss kan du följa din personliga karriärsväg.
* Vi tar vårt del av ansvaret för människor och miljö på allvar.


 Do you want to become part of the team?
   

  

 Apply directly online with your informative application documents and your earliest possible start date.
   

  

 Do you want more #insideCOSMO?

title: Management Consultant - AI & Digital Transformation
description:
Join our team at Curamando as
 **AI & Digital Transformation Consultant** 
 and play a key role in shaping the future of our growing Digital Transformation & AI practice. We work at the intersection of management consulting and hands-on digital transformation, partnering with market leaders to build lasting top-line growth and create significant efficiency gains in a collaborative, inclusive environment.
   

  

**About Curamando & Eidra**
 Curamando, part of the consultancy ecosystem Eidra, specializes in accelerating top-line growth through digital strategy, commercial execution, and tech-enabled innovation. We partner with industry leaders—from premium automotive brands to high-growth tech companies—to turn digital potential into tangible business results.
   

  

 Together with Eidra, we are building an international challenger in the consulting industry. Growing from a core team to over 1,500 experts across the Nordics, Europe, and the US (including Stockholm, Oslo, Gothenburg, Malmö, Amsterdam, Rotterdam, The Hague, Chicago, and New York), Eidra was built to claim a "new seat at the table." As a house of specialized brands, we combine top-tier strategic thinking with deep, cross-functional execution. Our work is grounded in Nordic values: openness, compassion, and grit, applied at a global scale.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Lead AI & digital transformations: Direct complex projects and programs that drive measurable top-line growth and digital capability maturity for our clients.
* Advise senior leaders: Build relationship and partner with senior leaders and directors on strategic initiatives requiring multi-disciplinary teams and high-impact change management.
* Scale our AI Practice: Actively contribute to our growing AI advisory, helping clients identify, validate, and integrate AI technologies into their core business operations.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration: Work seamlessly across Curamando's specialized teams and the broader Eidra network to bring the exact right blend of strategic, technical, and creative capabilities to every engagement.
* Mentor and develop talent: Guide junior consultants, foster knowledge-sharing, and contribute to our inclusive, performance-driven culture.
* Drive commercial growth: Spot expansion opportunities within client accounts, lead high-impact pitch processes and client proposals, close deals, fuelling Curamando’s pipeline and top-line performance.


 Who you are
   

  

* Consulting Experience: 2 – 5 years of management consulting experience from a recognized consulting firm or specialist advisory environment.
* Strategic & Practical Mindset: A strategic mindset paired with a pragmatic, hands-on approach, and a strong ability to structure complex problems and communicate recommendations clearly.
* Functional & AI Focus: Practical experience in digital transformation, digital marketing, sales, or AI, alongside experience utilizing AI tools and methodologies to enhance project delivery.
* Project & Delivery Experience: Track record of active participation in delivering digital transformation projects and engaging effectively with client stakeholders in complex environments.
* Cross-Functional Team Player: Demonstrated ability to thrive within multidisciplinary teams alongside subject matter experts across tech, design, and commercial strategy.
* Language Proficiency: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Swedish and English.
* Core Motivation: A genuine passion for business, people, and driving the mechanisms that allow organizations to achieve lasting change.


 What we offer
   

  

* High-impact client exposure: Direct visibility and strategic influence in executive rooms across international markets.
* Entrepreneurial house of brands: The culture and agility of a boutique consultancy paired with the reach, resources, and stability of a 1,500+ person firm.
* Greenfield AI opportunity: Help build and shape our rapidly growing AI practice across the Nordics and the Netherlands, giving you the chance to define methodologies rather than just inherit them.
* Clear career progression: Structured growth paths across multiple seniority levels tailored to your experience and ambitions.
* Cross-disciplinary learning: Continuous coaching and development across Eidra’s 14 specialist firms, with a global network of colleagues in the Nordics, the Netherlands, Germany, and the US to collaborate with.
* Human-centered workplace: A supportive culture prioritizing flexibility, continuous learning, and a true Nordic work-life balance.
* State-of-the-art Stockholm HQ: Work from our newly renovated office at Grev Tureplan in central Stockholm—a vibrant, inspiring hub shared with around 700 Eidra colleagues.


 Curamando offers tailored consulting services with the best people and assets to help clients build competitive digital marketing and sales capabilities to reach their business goals.
   

  

 We are a part of Eidra, a group of top-notch companies specializing in strategy, creativity, and engineering. As a collective we guide leaders in making meaningful and lasting change.

title: SMB Team Lead EMEA

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

**The role**
 As the SMB Team Lead, you will lead, coach, and scale a high-performing team of SMB Account Executives. You will be responsible for driving the execution of our small-business sales strategy, ensuring your team meets and exceeds their revenue targets.
   

  

 This is a role where you will not only manage pipeline and forecast accuracy but also actively mentor reps through complex deal cycles, refine their pitching mechanics, and foster a culture of continuous improvement.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Team Leadership & Coaching: Manage and mentor a team of SMB AEs. Conduct weekly 1:1s, live call coaching, and pipeline reviews to elevate the team’s sales acumen and execution.
* Revenue Delivery: Own the aggregate quota for the SMB segment. Ensure the team maintains a healthy, predictable pipeline and accurately forecasts monthly and quarterly revenue.
* Sales Execution: Actively jump into deals to support your reps. Help navigate objections, multi-stakeholder evaluations, and closing negotiations.

title: Utvecklingsledare digitalisering
description:
**Om arbetsplatsen**
 Sigtuna kommun är en plats med stor spännvidd. Här ryms levande landsbygd, småstad och en internationell flygplats. Ett rikt kulturarv och kulturell mångfald. En stolt historia och stora framtidsplaner. Kanske är det därför drivkraften är så stark att växa, förändras och utvecklas. Det är också därför det är så spännande att arbeta här. Hos oss blir du del av en prestigelös och nytänkande kultur där vi hjälps åt och tar tillvara på varandras kunskap, olikheter och erfarenheter. Arbetet är ofta omväxlande, ibland utmanande men alltid meningsfullt. Välkommen hit!
   

  

 Vård- och omsorgsförvaltningen ger service, stöd, vård och omsorg till äldre och personer med funktionsnedsättning samt ansvarar för myndighetsutövning enligt gällande lagstiftning. Förvaltningen bedriver verksamhet inom äldreomsorg, LSS, socialpsykiatri, hälso- och sjukvård, anhörigstöd och myndighetsutövning. Allt arbete utförs med invånaren i fokus med utgångspunkt i värdegrunden; bemötande, delaktighet, förtroende och trygghet. Tillsammans gör vi varandra bra och arbetar för att uppnå vård- och omsorgsförvaltningens vision livskvalitet hela livet.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
 Vår nuvarande utvecklingsledare går på föräldraledighet under 2027 och då har du chansen att söka denna spännande tjänst. Kanske är du nyfiken på Sigtuna kommun som arbetsgivare och vård- och omsorgsförvaltningen som arbetsplats, eller är det dags att prova ett nytt uppdrag?
   

  

 Vård- och omsorgsförvaltningen utvecklar nu sitt digitaliseringsarbete med fokus på ökad struktur, samordning och verksamhetsnytta. I rollen är du med och driver arbetet framåt genom att skapa struktur och tydlighet, samordna införandet av digitala tjänster och verksamhetssystem samt utveckla digitala arbetssätt som fungerar i praktiken. Tjänsten är ett vikariat under perioden 1 januari-31 december 2027 och är placerad i den nystartade staben för beredskap och digitalisering. Uppdraget är förvaltningsövergripande.
   

  

 Under 2027 har rollen två huvudsakliga fokusområden. Det ena är förvaltningens deltagande i ett ESF-finansierat projekt med fokus på digital kompetensutveckling, som genomförs i samverkan med Stockholms stad och AI Sweden. Projektet omfattar hälften av tjänsten. Här har du en central roll och arbetar nära projektledaren med att planera, samordna, genomföra och följa upp förvaltningens aktiviteter inom projektet.
   

  

 Det andra fokusområdet är att driva och samordna förvaltningens digitaliseringsarbete. Du skapar struktur och framdrift i införandet av digitala tjänster, verksamhetssystem och nya digitala arbetssätt, från planering och förankring till genomförande och uppföljning. Du håller också ihop och vidareutvecklar förvaltningens digitaliseringsorganisation och bidrar till tydliga arbetssätt, roller och ansvar.
   

  

 Därutöver deltar du i andra utvecklingsinitiativ inom digitaliseringsområdet och bidrar till kommunens övergripande digitaliseringsarbete. Beroende på uppdrag kan din roll vara drivande, samordnande eller deltagande. Arbetet sker i nära samverkan med verksamheterna, systemförvaltning och andra stödfunktioner inom förvaltningen samt med kommunövergripande funktioner.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
 Vi söker dig som har en universitets- eller högskoleexamen omfattande minst 180 hp, som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant. Du har flerårig erfarenhet av att självständigt driva och samordna utvecklingsarbete i en komplex organisation samt erfarenhet av digitalisering och verksamhetsutveckling.
   

  

 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att leda eller samordna införandet av digitala tjänster, verksamhetssystem eller andra digitala lösningar. Vi ser också gärna att du har erfarenhet av projektledning, förändringsledning eller andra större utvecklingsinitiativ.
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen behöver du arbeta strukturerat och kunna planera, organisera och driva ditt arbete framåt. Du har en god analytisk förmåga och kan sätta dig in i komplexa frågor, se samband och omsätta behov till konkreta aktiviteter och lösningar.
   

  

 Eftersom en stor del av uppdraget sker tillsammans med andra behöver du också ha en god samarbetsförmåga. Du är lyhörd för olika perspektiv, bidrar till ett prestigelöst samarbete och håller fokus på det gemensamma uppdraget.
   

  

 Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  

**Övrig information**
 Din ansökan gör du enkelt genom att bifoga ditt CV och svara på några urvalsfrågor kopplade till denna tjänst. Vi ber dig dock att inte bifoga personligt brev.
   

  

 Före erbjudande om anställning ska ett giltigt utdrag ur belastningsregistret uppvisas.
   

  

 Som anställd i Sigtuna kommun får du ta del av en rad förmåner, bl.a. blir du automatiskt medlem i Personalklubben där du kan ta delta i olika aktiviteter. Läs gärna mer om våra andra förmåner och hur det är att jobba hos oss i Sigtuna kommun! https://www.sigtuna.se/naringsliv-och-arbete/jobba-hos-oss.html
