title: Doktorand inom robotmanipulation av deformerbara objekt
description:
**Projektbeskrivning**




**Forskarutbildningsämne:** 
 Datalogi
   

  





 Doktoranden kommer att arbeta inom projektet GEOMANIP, ett ERC Starting Grant, som syftar till att revolutionera robotmanipulation av deformerbara objekt genom att blottlägga och utnyttja deras fundamentala geometriska natur. GEOMANIP föreslår ett paradigmskifte som integrerar differentialgeometrins struktur hos deformerbara objekt i nya kontinuumfysikinspirerade neurala representationer, vilka utgör grunden för en fysikaliskt förankrad manipuleringskedja som omfattar perception, planering och styrning. Doktoranden kommer att bidra till ett eller flera av följande ämnen: teoretiska grunder och geometrisk formalisering, representationsinlärning, robust perception och geometrisk tillståndsestimering samt policyinlärning och styrning av robotar.
   

  





**Handledning:** 
 Biträdande Universitetslektor Noémie Jaquier

* fullgjort kursfordringar om minst 240 högskolepoäng, varav minst 60 högskolepoäng på avancerad nivå, eller
* på något annat sätt inom eller utom landet förvärvat i huvudsak motsvarande kunskaper.



 Utöver ovanstående  finns också ett obligatoriskt krav på engelska motsvarande Engelska B/6.

* analysera och arbeta med komplexa frågor och
* uppvisa erfarenhet av programmeringsspråk som C++ eller Python.



 Vi söker kandidater med bakgrund inom maskininlärning, robotteknik och/eller differentialgeometri.
   

  





 Bakgrund inom differentialgeometri är en fördel. 
   

  





 Erfarenhet av riktiga robotar är en fördel
   

  





 Efter behörighetskraven kommer stor vikt läggas vid personliga egenskaper.
   

  





**Målexamen: Doktorsexamen**

 Du ansöker via KTH:s rekryteringssystem. Du som sökande har huvudansvaret för att din ansökan är komplett när den skickas in.

title: Automated consistency checking between safety concept and safety PLC code - 30hp
description:
##### **Elektroautomatik AB is a leading player in the automation industry, specializing in technology and automation. We want you to have the opportunity to work on something you are passionate about, leading to a more rewarding experience. Our focus is on matching the right person with thesis propsal.**

**The idea:**


Safety functions for a machine are specified in a spreadsheet, the blockschema, and implemented separately as a program in a failsafe PLC. Nothing checks automatically that the two agree. One person writes the blockschema, another writes the safety program. The spreadsheet is also used for several tests in the machine during commissioning which confirms machine behaviour is according to safety concept.


This thesis builds a tool that reads the implemented safety logic out of a Siemens TIA safety project, reads the specified safety logic out of the blockschema, puts both into the same model and reports the differences.


A second part of the work is deciding what that result is actually worth: what can be claimed about safety once such a check exists and what still has to be verified by a person.

##### **Background**

##### **The blockschema lists:**

* Every safety element (emergency stop, light curtain, interlocked guard, safe door lock, muting sensor, two hand control)
* How those elements are grouped into safety areas
* Which actuators (drives, contactors, valves, brakes) are brought to the safe state by which area


The safety program reproduces that table closely enough that an experienced engineer can read one and predict the other. That is what makes the correspondence checkable by machine in the first place.


One problem though is change. An extra door is added to an area during commissioning, or a drive moves from area 3 to area 4. The spreadsheet is updated and the program is not, or the other way round. The mismatch survives until validation testing, or it is not caught at all. Validation according to ISO 13849-2 is manual and has to be repeated after every modification, which means in practice it is repeated less thoroughly than it should be.

##### **Research questions**

* How completely can the implemented safety logic be recovered from a Siemens failsafe project, and what is lost in the process?
* Is there a representation expressive enough for both the informal specification and the implementation, and still simple enough to diff and explain?
* Which classes of deviation between specification and implementation are detectable this way, and which are not?
* What confidence gain can be claimed from an automated consistency check, given how the functional safety standards treat software tools?
* (Stage 4) Can a language model produce useful and traceable flags on safety concept documents without becoming a source of unjustified confidence?

##### **What you get out of it:**

* Functional safety work on real machines instead of textbook examples
* TIA Portal Openness, XML processing, graph modelling, static analysis of a graphical programming language
* A working knowledge of ISO 13849, IEC 62061 and IEC 61508, including the parts on software tools that most engineers never read
* A thesis with a concrete artefact and a concrete evaluation, which is a good combination to defend

#### **Who are you?**


You are in the final year of an engineering degree program specializing in automation, production, programming, or a related field.


You are able to be present at our facilities in Gothenburg at least three days a week.


Furthermore, we are looking for someone with a strong interest in technology and a desire to learn. You are responsible and structured in your work, and you excel at interacting, organizing, and coordinating your tasks with your supervisor. We also value a positive attitude and strong collaboration and communication skills.

#### **What we offer:**


We can offer you a role that is both challenging and tailored to your needs, ensuring you enjoy the assignment. You will be assigned a supervisor with whom you will have regular check-ins for support and guidance.


We also value a strong sense of community and therefore provide an office space for you to use during your thesis work, keeping you close to our team.

#### **About Elektroautomatik:**

Elektroautomatik is Sweden’s largest automation integrator and a full-service provider in the field of automation. We offer customized automation solutions, AGVs, high-quality machinery, training, and service that streamline and ensure the quality of our customers' production and logistics. With expertise spanning from initial concept to finished production and a broad range of competencies, we are a comprehensive partner for sustainable and innovative solutions.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
OHB Sweden is a leading Swedish supplier of space systems. We develop, build, test and commission satellites and subsystems for space missions in, for example, communication, earth observation and space research for institutional and commercial customers within and outside Europe. Building a satellite requires a broad range of expertise, involving the analysis, design, manufacturing, and testing of both hardware and software. At OHB Sweden, we offer engineers an exceptional opportunity to expand their technical skills across all domains.
  
  

We are seeking a skilled Senior Mechanical Engineer with space experience in the complete chain from CAD mechanical design, FEM analysis, and generation of production drawings to follow-on testing of the manufactured product. Collaborating with external partners (customers, payload suppliers, etc.) to define and implement mechanical interfaces will be an integral part of your daily responsibilities. What We’re Looking For: A structured, motivated, mechanical design engineer with proven leadership abilities. Ability to work independently while meeting agreed delivery schedules.
  
  

Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with diverse teams. Ability to plan and drive the success of our projects. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of space technology and eager to contribute to innovative satellite projects, we would love to hear from you! If you wish to have an active role in the development of future space systems, feel confident that your experience and qualifications match the above requirements and want to find yourself in a dynamic and inspiring work environment, then we very much look forward to hearing from you!
  
  

**Task Description:** Having a lead role on design of mechanical, structural, and dynamic components using CAD and FEM, focusing on stress, shock, and random vibration analyses. Oversee the generation of manufacturing drawings from CAD models, using GPS tolerancing. Lead technical discussions with customers and suppliers. Supervise off-site manufacturing of parts and inspect delivered items.
  
  

Support on-site assembly of end products, such as spacecraft structures. Define and design test specifications, procedures, and setups for subsystem qualification (structures, mechanisms, units, components, actuators). Correlate FE models (e.g., fundamental frequencies, damping coefficients) with actual test results. Assist in planning and budgeting for future programs and projects.
  
  

Design, assemble, and test mechanical ground support equipment (MGSE) for integration and test activities. Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance within the team. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Space Engineering, or related disciplines. Minimum of 7 years of experience in design and testing environments related to CAD, mechanical FEM analysis, and design.
  
  

Proven ability to lead and inspire teams and/or groups, driving projects forward. Experience within ESA projects. Good knowledge of the ECSS. Expertise with CREO, Catia, NX, or similar.
  
  

CREO is the tool we use. Proficiency in FEM analysis, particularly in random vibration response, shock, and loads analysis. Ability to generate, read, and understand mechanical design/analysis reports and Interface Control Documents (ICDs). Clear and coherent reporting and presentation skills in English.
  
  

Experience in design-to-manufacture processes. Fluent in English, both spoken and written. Located in or willing to relocate to Stockholm, Sweden. Added Advantageous Qualifications: Experience in writing test procedures for vibration and shock.
  
  

Experience in requirements management and verification. Proficiency with NASTRAN/Altair Experience with CREO and/or NX (CAD) and Windchill PLM. Experience working closely with production/MAIT. Experience in GPS (Geometric Product Specifications) drawing production.
  
  

Knowledge of the European Cooperation for Space Standardization (ECSS) and experience in the space industry. Why Join Us? Join us and work in a dynamic, international environment with exciting collaborations across Europe, while developing your technical expertise from mechanical design to system engineering. Be part of a dedicated team of specialists in systems, electrical, thermal, and AIT, contributing to the development of cutting-edge satellites.
  
  

You’ll also take ownership of customer and supplier relations, gaining valuable experience in project management and high-level networking. If you feel confident that you meet the above requirements, then we are looking forward to hearing from you! ️

title: Senior Systems Engineer – Satellite Communications at Ovzon
description:
At Ovzon, you will work with the space-based systems that enable satellite communications when terrestrial infrastructure is insufficient, unavailable or disrupted. The role combines RF engineering and system-level design with requirements engineering, procurement, supplier collaboration and verification. About the role Ovzon develops and delivers integrated mobile satellite communication services. Its communications system includes Ovzon 3, the company’s proprietary geostationary satellite, featuring steerable spot beams and an On-Board Processor that enables communication even when ground infrastructure is limited or unavailable.
  
  

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will work at the heart of Ovzon’s technical organization and take responsibility for how the communications system is designed, specified and verified as a whole. The role requires a broad system perspective: understanding how different technical domains interact, evaluating alternative solutions and ensuring that external suppliers meet defined requirements. You will be based at Ovzon’s Stockholm office, where much of the company’s technical development takes place. The workplace combines a highly specialized engineering environment with an open, forward-looking culture and close collaboration across technical disciplines.
  
  

Many colleagues bring experience from the space industry and strong academic backgrounds, creating an environment where technical discussions, shared learning and complex problem-solving are part of the day-to-day work. With additional offices in the United States, you will also be part of an international organization with connections across teams and markets. Responsibilities You will work across the full development chain, from technical needs and system requirements to delivered and verified solutions. Your responsibilities will include: Developing, structuring and maintaining technical requirements for satellite communication systems.
  
  

Contributing to system-level design and evaluating alternative technologies and technical trade-offs. Preparing technical documentation for procurement processes and evaluating proposals and supplier solutions. Reviewing technical documentation and ensuring that partners and suppliers meet defined requirements. Developing and reviewing RF, link and capacity budgets.
  
  

Defining verification plans and acceptance criteria, and supporting the validation team with system knowledge and test planning. Managing regulatory requirements within radio communications and contributing to cybersecurity requirements for the communications system. Coordinating technical matters across internal specialists, partners and suppliers, and leading smaller technical projects when required. We are looking for someone whoHolds a relevant technical degree, for example in electrical engineering, engineering physics, space engineering, telecommunications or systems engineering.
  
  

Has several years of relevant experience in systems engineering, requirements engineering or technically advanced communication systems. Has practical experience of formulating, structuring or following up technical requirements. Can understand complex systems and the interfaces between areas such as RF, networks, software, hardware and external subsystems. Is comfortable reading, writing and assessing technical documentation.
  
  

Is fluent in English, both spoken and written. It is considered an advantage if you have: A Systems Engineering certification, such as ASEP or CSEP. Experience in satellite communications, radio communications, telecommunications or other RF-based systems. Worked with RF or link budgets, frequency planning or regulatory matters within radio communications.
  
  

Experience in technical procurement, proposal evaluation or requirements management involving external suppliers. Worked with verification planning, requirements traceability or validation of complex systems. Experience of cybersecurity requirements for communication systems. description:
### **Job description**


Har du erfarenhet av elektronikutveckling och PCB-design och vill arbeta med kompletta systemlösningar? Vi söker en **systemingenjör med fokus på elektronik**, som vill kombinera tekniskt djup med ett brett systemperspektiv.


I rollen arbetar du mot vår kunds avdelning som utvecklar och levererar skräddarsydda IT-produkter och kompletta IT-lösningar efter kundernas behov och specifikationer.


Du deltar genom hela utvecklingsprocessen – från kravanalys och tekniska koncept till konstruktion, integration och verifiering. Med din kunskap inom kretskort och elektronikkonstruktion bidrar du till tekniska vägval och säkerställer att elektroniken fungerar tillsammans med systemets övriga delar.


Du arbetar nära ingenjörer inom elektronik, mjukvara, mekanik och andra teknikområden för att skapa robusta och väl fungerande helhetslösningar. Rollen innebär både arbete med elektronikutveckling och ansvar för gränssnitt, krav och integration på systemnivå.

* Högskole- eller civilingenjörsutbildning inom elektronik, elektroteknik, mekatronik eller motsvarande praktisk erfarenhet.

* Förståelse för hur elektronik integreras i kompletta produkter och system.

Du är nyfiken, drivande och har ett tydligt tekniskt helhetsperspektiv. Du trivs med att förstå hur olika delar av ett system påverkar varandra och omsätta den förståelsen till konkreta lösningar.

title: Process Engineer
description:
**Din nya utmaning**


Som Process Engineer blir du en del av vårt NPI-team och får en viktig roll i att utveckla och förbättra våra produktionsprocesser inom montering och test. Du arbetar för att säkerställa effektiva, stabila och standardiserade processer som möter våra krav på kvalitet, kostnad och leverans.


I rollen arbetar du bland annat med att utveckla produktionsflöden, ta fram arbetsinstruktioner och validera processer. Du stöttar även vid prototyp- och pilotproduktion och arbetar löpande med att hitta förbättringar inom exempelvis kvalitet, produktivitet och ergonomi.


Du arbetar nära bland annat projektledning, konstruktion, produktion, kvalitet och test för att säkerställa en smidig övergång från produktutveckling till serieproduktion. En viktig del av rollen är också att identifiera och lösa problem i våra processer genom analys och strukturerad problemlösning.


Du rapporterar till NPI Manager.

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**

* Utveckla, implementera och förbättra produktionsprocesser inom montering och test.
* Analysera befintliga processer och identifiera förbättringar inom kvalitet, produktivitet, ergonomi och effektivitet.
* Utveckla och dokumentera produktionsflöden, arbetsinstruktioner och standardiserade arbetssätt.
* Stötta industrialiseringen av nya produkter och säkerställa att produktionen är redo inför serieproduktion.

* Delta i DFM- och DFT-arbete för att säkerställa att nya produkter är anpassade för effektiv produktion och testning.
* Driva och delta i kontinuerligt förbättringsarbete, exempelvis genom Lean, Six Sigma och rotorsaksanalys.

* Felsöka produktions- och testrelaterade problem samt ta fram och implementera långsiktiga lösningar.

**Vi söker dig med**

**Lär känna oss**


På MilDef blir du en del av ett företag som värdesätter praktiskt engagemang, gemenskap och utveckling av ledande försvarsteknik. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utveckla nya färdigheter, bidra i tvärfunktionella projekt och göra en konkret skillnad för vår fortsatta framgång. Vi uppmuntrar kontinuerligt lärande, samarbete, och erbjuder goda möjligheter till karriärutveckling. Vi är stolta över att aktivt främja hälsa och balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Vi genomför drogtester på alla våra framtida kollegor innan anställning.

title: Staff/Lead Fullstack Engineer (Frontend-focused)
description:
**What we are building**
------------------------


Mimica is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start.


Mimica automatically analyzes your team’s work, then generates the AI agents to execute it. Our software turns everyday work into data-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence.


We’ve raised $26 million in Series B financing and are scaling fast. Backed by investors including Khosla Ventures and Paladin Capital, our proprietary AI technology is trusted by Fortune 500 companies to accelerate transformation. Mimica is recognized as a Top 100 AI Start-up by Accel and an industry Leader by the Everest Group.  

  

**Our team**


Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI.

**Where we are in our scale-up journey**  

  

We’ve achieved strong product-market fit and are now scaling with intention. You’ll join a 60-person team of Senior+ engineers and Product leaders who prioritise product impact over mere headcount. We have 8 cross-functional teams, including a dedicated Platform team focused on infra & developer experience. We started building proprietary ML before the LLM boom, so we don't just consume models - we train them from the ground up.  

  



**Our approach to engineering**

* We prioritize customer needs first
* We work in small, cross-functional, feature-oriented teams
* We have flexibility in terms of the problems we work on
* We own the full lifecycle of our projects
* We avoid silos and encourage taking up tasks in new areas
* We balance quality and velocity
* We have a shared responsibility for our production code
* We each set our own routine to maximize our productivity

### **Your mission**


You will join our Mapper Team, whose goal is to produce and service the Process Maps that are at the core of Mimica's product.


We found good product-market fit, which means two things: building new features and making architectural decisions that will enable exponential growth in usage.


You will take ownership of projects end-to-end, build new features, release improvements to existing components, and take operational responsibility for what you build.


We have a bottom-up culture where Engineers identify pain points, experiment with and iterate on their solutions, and leverage tight feedback loops.


As such, you‘ll have the opportunity to shape the technical direction, processes and culture of the Engineering org, Chapter and Team.

### **Part of your day-to-day**

* Developing data-visualisation applications and new features around displaying significant large data properties (e.g., insights regarding processes, workflows and metrics) in effective ways, with scalability & reliability in mind.
* Building interfaces and real-time frontend services that enable multiple users to edit graph data and re-train AI models through their input.
* Owning projects end-to-end as part of small teams, collaborating with our TLs and Product Managers.
* Participating in architectural decisions, collaborating across teams to identify and implement product improvements and producing documentation for your implementations.
* Participate in and improve the Team's and Chapter's internal processes and rituals so that we're more effective.
* Providing feedback to peers through RFCs, code reviews and helping those around you to level up.
* Participating in hiring and onboarding new team members.

### **Who you are**

* You have at least**8+ years** of experience as a Software Engineer and high engineering standards.
* Strong experience and understanding of **React****, state management, front-end architecture & concepts.**
* **Knowledge of advanced system design principles**, **data structures, algorithms, and the core concepts underlying** **data-intensive applications****.**
* **Deep understanding of advanced performance** **optimisation techniques**.
* **Previous experience working in the backend.**
* Committed to upholding high engineering standards, delivering clean, testable, reusable, modular, and well-documented code.
* Experience owning projects from start to finish, including speccing, design, development, testing, deployment, release and observability.
* Drive to develop your skills, improve team processes and reduce debt.
* **Fluency in English, with effective communication skills** – articulating complex ideas, concepts and trade-offs clearly.

### **Bonus**

* Background working in fast-paced, successful **scale-up** environments or **as a founding engineer**, with a track record of delivering value quickly and iteratively alongside building processes.
* Graph or Canvas-based Rendering, or graph/geometry editing. (FE-focused).

 **Location**


This is a fully remote position. To ensure effective collaboration with our team, we are only considering candidates in the following regions:

* **Europe & Africa:** Locations within European timezones (typically **UTC-1 to UTC+3**).
* **The Americas:** Locations in the **Eastern Time Zone** (e.g., US East Coast, Toronto) or **UTC-3** (e.g., Brazil, Argentina)

title: Field Service Engineer
description:
Job Description
**Your role**
-------------

We’re looking for a hands-on Field Service Engineer to support our customers across the Nordic, with a primary base in Södertälje area.


This is a varied role combining skilled on-site support, software setup and support, tooling repair, preventative maintenance, installation and customer-facing technical expertise. You’ll work across a wide range of assembly tooling, including pneumatic and electric tools, while also supporting projects and continuous improvement activities. If you enjoy problem-solving, working independently, and being the technical expert customers rely on, this role will suit you. Whether you're an experienced engineer or looking to take the next step in your engineering career, you'll receive the training and support needed to develop your technical skills and build specialist knowledge. Through your work, you’ll help customers secure the uptime and performance they rely on to run their operations with confidence.  



**What your day could look like:** No two days are the same. You could be diagnosing a tooling fault on a production line, carrying out preventative maintenance, installing new equipment, calibrating torque tooling, supporting a customer project or delivering technical training.  



**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide day-to-day technical support at our customers' sites across the Nordic.
* Perform installation, service, and repair of assembly tooling whilst ensuring safety compliance and documenting activities.
* Carry out preventative maintenance and calibration activities.
* Installation, set-up and modification of process control software and related tooling software.
* Support assembly projects and customer rework requests.
* Deliver product training and technical guidance to customers when required.
* Work closely with internal teams and sales to resolve application challenges.
* Promote company products, services, and solutions through strong customer relationships.
Maintain awareness of competitor products and industry developments.  
* 
**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

**Essential:** Practical mechanical and/or electrical engineering aptitude, with an ability to diagnose faults using a logical and methodical approach. Comfortable using computers and technical software, with the ability and willingness to learn new software systems. Experience with industrial tooling, automation or manufacturing equipment is essential. Experience with our specific tooling and systems will be developed through training and ongoing technical development. Logical approach to fault finding. Ability to work independently and manage your own workload. Good communication skills, including customer interaction and presentations. Driving licence and willingness to travel.  



**Training & Development:** Full training will be provided on our tooling, software and systems. The role provides an opportunity to develop skills across mechanical engineering, electrical systems, industrial automation, torque control and customer applications. For candidates early in their career, this is an opportunity to develop into a highly skilled Field Service Engineer with increasing responsibility for customer projects and technical support.  



**What success looks like:** Within your first 6–12 months, you will be developing the technical knowledge and confidence to independently diagnose tooling and process issues, support customers on-site and complete routine service, repair and calibration activities. As your experience develops, you will take greater responsibility for customer projects, software configuration and technical problem solving.  



**Personal Attributes:** Self-motivated and proactive. Customer-focused with a professional approach. Strong team player with good interpersonal skills. Flexible and adaptable to changing workloads and travel requirements. Positive attitude with a willingness to learn and develop. Flexibility to work occasional weekends based on business needs.  



**Required languages:** Swedish and English  



**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

**Why join us**

Work with advanced industrial tooling and automation technology. Gain experience across mechanical, electrical and software engineering. Work directly with major manufacturing customers. Full technical training and ongoing development. Build specialist knowledge in torque and assembly technology.

Founded in 1914 Desoutter Industrial Tools is a global leader in electric assembly tools serving a wide range of assembly and manufacturing operations, including Aerospace, Automotive, Light and Heavy Vehicles, Off-Road, General Industry. Desoutter offers a comprehensive range of Solutions (tools, service and projects) to meet the specific demands of local and global customers in over 170 countries. The company designs, develops and delivers innovative quality industrial tool solutions, including air and electric Screwdrivers, Advanced Assembly Tools, Advanced Drilling Units and Torque Measurement.

Remote
  

This role is based in Södertälje area

Ethena has quickly established itself as the fastest growing and most innovative financial product utilising digital asset technology to date.  At Qliro we deliver safe and simple payments. We are a dedicated partner to our merchants who serve their customers every day. We believe that if our merchants grow, we grow. We’re in the early stages of exploring how AI can help us make better credit and fraud decisions, and we’re honest that this is genuinely complex territory. Credit is one of the most regulated areas when it comes to AI: explainability, fairness, and auditability aren’t optional. We want someone who finds that complexity interesting, not someone who pretends it isn’t there.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Experience in modernizing and migrating legacy systems
* Practical experience with agile engineering methods and solid software engineering best practices
* Strong understanding of system design, data structures, and API development
* A mindset that values speed, correctness, and reliability, especially in microservices and event‑driven architectures


 It is beneficial if you have experience from:
   

  

* Working with credit engines, credit decisioning, or similar financial decision systems

title: ISAC System Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
 Shape networks that don't just connect — they sense, interpret and respond.
   

  

 Ericsson is building the next generation of intelligent communication systems, and we need an expert to help define it. Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) sits at the intersection of telecommunications, radar and radio-based sensing, signal processing, AI and network architecture — an emerging market. If you have deep ISAC expertise and want to influence how future networks perceive and act on their environment, this is your next challenge.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You'll join the Early System & Concept Evaluation team within our Radio Access Network (RAN) system architecture organization. We analyse future requirements, design system architectures, build prototypes and prepare the concepts behind Ericsson's next generations of solutions. ISAC is a new business segment that adds functions and requirements to existing telecom architectures — and you'll work alongside RAN experts to define how sensing capabilities integrate into future networks.
   

  

**About This Opportunity**
 You'll transform ISAC from an emerging concept into coherent, deployable, commercially relevant system solutions. Working across RAN and radio systems, sensing workflows and measurement control, signal processing, sensor fusion, object detection and tracking, distributed processing, core and management networks, data and APIs, and customer-facing applications, your job is to define how these domains work together as one integrated solution.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Translate customer, business, use-case and regulatory needs into clear system requirements and technical priorities.
* Define ISAC system architectures and the changes required in existing RAN and core network structures.
* Develop system concepts and implementation proposals with RAN experts and other technology teams.
* Analyze interfaces, dependencies, operational requirements and design trade-offs across the full ISAC solution.
* Specify sensing workflow management and sensing measurement control.
* Shape solutions for distributed processing and multi-client exposure of sensing results.
* Identify technical gaps, risks and opportunities early, and drive consistent alignment across teams.
* Contribute to prototypes, technology evaluations and early product concepts, and establish scalable, reusable architectural principles.
* Interact with Product management to set requirements
* Interact with and guide 3GPP delegates


**ISAC competence we're looking for**
* Expert knowledge of Integrated Sensing and Communication, radar or radio-based sensing — ideally including monostatic/bistatic/multistatic sensing geometries and joint communication-and-sensing (JCAS) waveform considerations.
* Sensing systems depth: object detection, tracking, target measurement (range, Doppler, angle) and sensor fusion.
* Signal processing for sensing: detection and estimation, clutter and interference handling, and tracking filters.
* RAN and telecom system architecture, and how sensing functions map onto 5G/6G RAN and core structures.
* Practical experience in one or more of the following: sensing workflow management and measurement control, distributed processing and multi-client exposure of sensing results, data management and API-based system integration, antenna and array understanding and its consequences and link budget and coverage analysis.
* Turning complex business, customer, use-case and regulatory needs into system requirements.
* Strong systems thinking: seeing relationships across technical domains and communicating them clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.


**The challenges you will enjoy**
 This role suits someone who thrives when the solution doesn't exist yet. ISAC introduces new functions across both RAN and core networks, so success depends on understanding the complete system — not just one domain — and continuously weighing interfaces, performance, deployment and operational trade-offs. You'll be comfortable where requirements are evolving, standards are still forming, and technical direction is shaped through collaboration, analysis and experimentation.
   

  

**Why it matters**
 ISAC is a significant evolution of wireless networks: future networks won't only connect people, devices and machines — they'll also sense and describe the world around them, enabling intelligent transportation, industrial automation, robotics, smart infrastructure, security and advanced positioning. Join now and you'll help define a technology area that is still being written — influencing the architectures, concepts and market approach Ericsson takes.
   

  

**Is this you?**
 You're a recognized technical expert who moves confidently between strategy and detail, enjoys interdisciplinary problems, and influences decisions through insight rather than authority. You're comfortable challenging existing approaches, creating clarity in uncertainty, and you want to help define the future of intelligent networks.
   

  

 Join Ericsson and help shape the networks that will not only communicate — but sense, understand and respond to the world around them.
   

  

**Why join Ericsson?**
 At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.
   

  

**What happens once you apply?**
 Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

 Sweden (SE) || Stockholm

title: Senior Systems Engineer / Satellite Communications at Ovzon
description:
At Ovzon, you will work with the space-based systems that enable satellite communications when terrestrial infrastructure is insufficient, unavailable or disrupted. The role combines RF engineering and system-level design with requirements engineering, procurement, supplier collaboration and verification.
 



  





**About the role** 




 Ovzon develops and delivers integrated mobile satellite communication services. Its communications system includes Ovzon 3, the company’s proprietary geostationary satellite, featuring steerable spot beams and an On-Board Processor that enables communication even when ground infrastructure is limited or unavailable.
 



  





 As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will work at the heart of Ovzon’s technical organization and take responsibility for how the communications system is designed, specified and verified as a whole. The role requires a broad system perspective: understanding how different technical domains interact, evaluating alternative solutions and ensuring that external suppliers meet defined requirements.
 



  





 You will be based at Ovzon’s Stockholm office, where much of the company’s technical development takes place. The workplace combines a highly specialized engineering environment with an open, forward-looking culture and close collaboration across technical disciplines. Many colleagues bring experience from the space industry and strong academic backgrounds, creating an environment where technical discussions, shared learning and complex problem-solving are part of the day-to-day work. With additional offices in the United States, you will also be part of an international organization with connections across teams and markets.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 You will work across the full development chain, from technical needs and system requirements to delivered and verified solutions. Your responsibilities will include:
 


* Developing, structuring and maintaining technical requirements for satellite communication systems.
* Contributing to system-level design and evaluating alternative technologies and technical trade-offs.
* Preparing technical documentation for procurement processes and evaluating proposals and supplier solutions.
* Reviewing technical documentation and ensuring that partners and suppliers meet defined requirements.
* Developing and reviewing RF, link and capacity budgets.
* Defining verification plans and acceptance criteria, and supporting the validation team with system knowledge and test planning.
* Managing regulatory requirements within radio communications and contributing to cybersecurity requirements for the communications system.
* Coordinating technical matters across internal specialists, partners and suppliers, and leading smaller technical projects when required.



  





**We are looking for someone who** 



* Holds a relevant technical degree, for example in electrical engineering, engineering physics, space engineering, telecommunications or systems engineering.
* Has several years of relevant experience in systems engineering, requirements engineering or technically advanced communication systems.
* Has practical experience of formulating, structuring or following up technical requirements.
* Can understand complex systems and the interfaces between areas such as RF, networks, software, hardware and external subsystems.
* Is comfortable reading, writing and assessing technical documentation.
* Is fluent in English, both spoken and written.



  





 It is considered an advantage if you have:
 


* A Systems Engineering certification, such as ASEP or CSEP.
* Experience in satellite communications, radio communications, telecommunications or other RF-based systems.
* Worked with RF or link budgets, frequency planning or regulatory matters within radio communications.
* Experience in technical procurement, proposal evaluation or requirements management involving external suppliers.
* Worked with verification planning, requirements traceability or validation of complex systems.
* Experience of cybersecurity requirements for communication systems.
* Professional working proficiency in Swedish.



  





 To succeed in the role, you combine technical curiosity with a structured and pragmatic approach. You can move between detailed requirements and the wider system perspective, document your conclusions and drive technical matters forward even when all the answers are not yet available. You collaborate closely with specialists and suppliers while taking ownership of your analyses and follow-up.
 



  





**About the employment** 




 This is a consultancy assignment, which means that you will initially be employed by Friday. The shared intention of Friday and Ovzon is for you to transition to direct employment with Ovzon after 12 months.
 



  





 Applicants who already have the legal right to work in Sweden will be prioritized. Work permit sponsorship may be considered in exceptional cases.
 



  





**Practical information** 



* Employment: Full-time
* Start date: By agreement
* Location: Stockholm
* Salary: Market-aligned monthly salary
* Contact person: Anna Persson



  





**About Friday** 




 Friday connects technical specialists with companies where their knowledge and ambitions can develop over time. We take the time to understand what you are looking for and match you with roles that fit both your experience and your next career step.
 



  





 We value potential and ambition and work actively toward an inclusive recruitment process in which candidates are assessed on relevant qualifications and experience.
 



  





 Friday has offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Linköping and Örebro. Each year, we conduct more than 5,000 career meetings and recruit technical specialists for organisations ranging from international companies to growing technology businesses.
